legend.fn_sub: Numbered in story order. Each note sits straight below its marks on the lines above.

episodes.title: How to Destroy the Unstable SMP
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: SpokeIsHere and JamatoP find long-patched exploits working again. They dupe items and hide glitch machines under five Wonders, but with Wemmbu suspicious and Jamato quitting, Spoke nukes the Wonders with a TNT cannon.

episodes.title: This Button Destroys the World
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: ParrotX2 builds his own orbital TNT cannon to stop Spoke's from destroying the Wonders, and catches Wemmbu and Roshambogames hiding duped items. The guardians sabotage him, and the last Wonder falls.

episodes.title: Breaking Into Minecraft's Most Illegal Vault
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu spies on Spoke's exploits and fights him in the End, then breaks into Spoke's giant vault millions of blocks out, battling its guards. Spoke springs a prison trap on him, but Wemmbu escapes.

episodes.title: How I Stole 10,356,000 Duped Items
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Spoke and Mapicc raid Roshambogames's vaults to destroy every duped item, but their orbital strike wipes out innocent Jepexx's home. They find the real final vault and claim Roshambo's End base.

episodes.title: I Uncovered Minecraft's Greatest Secret
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Spoke sends Parrot and his friend Wifies on a scavenger hunt of clue discs. It's revenge: Wifies sacrifices himself to a chunk ban (a trap that bans whoever enters), and Spoke then steps in too.

episodes.title: It's Impossible to Catch this Player
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu allies with PrinceZam of the Zam Empire to hunt Spoke, banning his henchmen one by one with chunk bans. After a long chase, Spoke steps into a chunk ban rather than be killed.

episodes.title: I Broke into Minecraft's Most Secure Prison
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: To free Wifies, Parrot and rekrap2 break into PrinceZam's prisons, freeing Derapchu, Fantst and JumperWho. With escape expert _Kenadian_, they blow up the chunk ban holding Wifies and Spoke.

episodes.title: I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: PrinceZam has Wemmbu build a colony to guard her vault. With Eggchan he founds the Wemmbu Civilization and shelters Parrot, then finds the vault empty and Zam behind the attacks as her guards blow it up.

episodes.title: I Got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Players
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Hunted by hired killer ClownPierce, Parrot teams up with Leow0ok's Clown hunters and kidnaps Clown's friend BranzyCraft but spares him. He lures Clown into a duel over a huge TNT trap under his castle.

episodes.title: Why I Destroyed the Unstable SMP
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Broke, Wemmbu and Eggchan sell griefing services, blowing up bases for paying clients like the Treasure Hunters. Then they team with Parrot and Wifies to rob the Treasure Hunters and declare war on PrinceZam.

episodes.title: I Bankrupted Minecraft's Richest Civilization
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Spoke and Mapicc tour the server's farms to cut off Roshambo's riches, helped by friendly stranger ashwagg. Ignoring Mapicc's warnings, Spoke trusts him, and Ash blows up nearly every farm and frames them.

episodes.title: It's Impossible to Find this Player
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Seeking missing friends, Parrot and Wifies complete quests to recover each friend's prized item while the thieving Treasure Hunters interfere. ClownPierce reveals the prize: Proton, a high-security prison.

episodes.title: Unstable SMP: The PrinceZam Empire War
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu wages war on the Zam Empire, kidnapping PrinceZam's officers with defector ManePear, but Zam bombs his civilization and captures Eggchan. He frees Egg, nukes the empire, then ClownPierce kidnaps him and Zam.

episodes.title: How I Escaped Minecraft's Largest Prison
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Locked by ClownPierce in Proton, a walled prison world, Wemmbu and Eggchan uneasily ally with PrinceZam. Kenadian designs an ender pearl cannon, and Egg stays behind so Wemmbu can launch himself to freedom.

episodes.title: Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Imprisoned in Proton, Parrot secretly signals fellow prisoners in Morse code and learns Kenadian designed the prison. With gear Wemmbu smuggles in, they break out; Ken stays behind but leaves a way to pull her out.

episodes.title: I Built Minecraft's Safest Civilization
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Parrot and Wifies found a hidden civilization deep in the End, recruiting Mafia defector Deanthebean9 and winning an election against Boosfer. When the Invisible Mafia raids it, Parrot blows it up himself.

episodes.title: How I Solved Minecraft's Largest Escape Room
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu and PrinceZam must solve a vast multi-room escape room ClownPierce had built. They finish by crafting a mace and reach the End, where Wemmbu fights Clown until he flees.

episodes.title: I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Caught robbing Reddoons, Parrot, Wifies and Dean are made to mine diamond quotas in the Mafia's Mining City. They rob vaults to free miners, but Reddoons kills their friend LuigiToan and ashwagg tries to recruit them.

episodes.title: I Got Hunted by the Minecraft Mafia
lines: I Got Hunted by the Minecraft
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Hunted by ashwagg's Invisible Mafia, Spoke and Mapicc team up with ex-member MinuteTech, but Mapicc is captured, Squiddo betrays them and Minute rejoins the Mafia. His old exploits are patched; he finds JamatoP's will.

episodes.title: I Discovered a Minecraft Sky Civilization
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu is forced to join the secretive Skyblock Civilization under leader Jaron and enforcer Straight. He exposes Jaron's hidden contraband, but Straight opens a portal and lets the Mafia raid the city.

episodes.title: The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Parrot, Wifies and Dean trek toward the Far Lands city to avenge Luigi, hunted by the Mafia all the way. Dean admits leaking their location and leaves, Wifies burns the compass, and Parrot arrives alone.

episodes.title: I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: With PlanetLord and Leow0ok, Spoke goes undercover in the Mafia as 'Fish Bucket', rescuing Mapicc and climbing the ranks, even killing an innocent player. At his promotion duel, MinuteTech turns on ashwagg with them.

episodes.title: I Mastered Minecraft Combat
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: ManePear trains Wemmbu to fight while they hunt high-ranking Mafia members, and Wemmbu masters the mace. FlameFrags holds Eggchan hostage to take the mace, and Mane vanishes, leaving a sign: 'lost cause'.

episodes.title: Unstable SMP: The First War
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: In Horace's Far Lands city, Parrot joins the Warriors, wins a council seat and ousts leader Purpled to unite them with the Farmers. Dean dies trying to win back his trust, and ashwagg's Mafia destroys the city.

episodes.title: Unstable SMP: Doomsday
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Parrot leads a shrinking resistance from a bunker, District 13, and ashwagg kills Wifies. Spoke breaks the Mafia's hold on its members, Parrot lights beacons as they drop their invisibility, and Ash names 'The Director'.

episodes.title: Unstable SMP: The Mafia
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: After ClownPierce burns their treehouse, Wemmbu joins Parrot's resistance just long enough to win a mace, then takes FerreMC's mace too. He distracts the Mafia during a prison break, then leaves with Eggchan.

episodes.title: The End of the Minecraft Mafia
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Spoke and Mapicc learn from Quackenstein where the Mafia stores the ender pearls it uses to kill disloyal members. Spoke destroys every pearl, ending the Mafia, then spares ashwagg and sends him into exile.

episodes.title: Unstable SMP: After The Mafia
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Seeking peace in a Pale Garden, Wemmbu and Eggchan are harassed by TheobaldTheBird, who wants a fight. With Kenadian's defenses they hold out until Theo takes her hostage; Wemmbu wins the duel.

episodes.title: I Got Hunted by the World's Best Minecraft Player
lines: I Got Hunted by the World's
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: World-class fighter ItzRealMe hunts Parrot, who is taken in by Leow0ok's bounty hunter team BAT. After going it alone fails, BAT rescues him and he joins them; Itz reveals The Director ordered the hit.

episodes.title: Unstable SMP: The Eggchan Empire
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu and Eggchan build an empire on ManePear's old land, with Wemmbu hunting experience bottles to pay citizens. Pirate leader Jaden_MAN lures him away and takes Egg hostage, forcing Wemmbu to surrender.

episodes.title: I Got Hunted by a Minecraft Redstone Genius
lines: I Got Hunted by a Minecraft
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Trap maker MrCube6 targets Parrot inside BAT's base with void traps and bombs. Parrot and an overlooked Derapchu recover stolen gear and capture Cube, who escapes but leaves a book from The Director.

episodes.title: I Spent 100 Days Hidden in a Secret Minecraft Base...
lines: I Spent 100 Days Hidden in a
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Spoke secretly lives 100 days inside ashwagg's hidden base, spying on Ash and Squiddo and stealing their loot by hijacking a trade with Reddoons. Ash reveals he gave the Dragon Egg to Reddoons, so Spoke goes after it.

episodes.title: I Explored a Deserted Minecraft Civilization
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Launched with Eggchan to the lawless Pirate Islands, Wemmbu scavenges gear, frees Egg and battles Jaden_MAN and Arcn. A hidden helper, TheobaldTheBird, helps him destroy the pirates' pearl cannon and beat Jaden.

episodes.title: I Got Hunted by Minecraft Bounty Hunters
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Framed as The Director inside BAT, Parrot goes on the run, and JumperWho secretly helps him by disguising him as a spy. The Director finally meets Parrot, admits killing Wifies and escapes; Jumper then leaves BAT.

episodes.title: I Survived 100 Days Inside a Hidden Minecraft Base
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Chasing the Dragon Egg, Spoke secretly moves into Reddoons and Yeah_Jaron's base, where Mapicc and PlanetLord join him. They prank Jaron and raid the vaults, but Reddoons grabs the Egg, and Spoke vows to haunt him.

episodes.title: I Explored an Abandoned Minecraft Civilization
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu chases Jaden_MAN into an abandoned, warden-filled civilization, teaming with Eggchan, loppezz and peaceful Rejoicin. After Jaden's wardens kill Rejoicin, Wemmbu beats Jaden but strips him and leaves him alive.

episodes.title: 100 Days Hidden in a Minecraft Chunk Base
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Spoke spends 100 days hidden in Reddoons and Yeah_Jaron's top base, secretly siphoning their farms and meddling in their trades. When bandits raid it, his trap accidentally blows up the whole base and he flees.

episodes.title: How I SURVIVED the Unstable SMP
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Starting over, Wemmbu and Eggchan raid rival teams for leather, books and cows until Egg leaves to focus on his studies. Wemmbu wipes out a whole team, then fights FlameFrags in a rematch that ends in a disputed draw.

episodes.title: I Became Immortal on a Hardcore Minecraft Server
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: Feared fighter FlameFrags sets out to rebuild a full netherite set, beating trappers, Spoke's hired squads and BAT's spies. After a drawn rematch with Wemmbu, he survives Spoke's traps and completes his armor.

episodes.title: I Got Hunted by a Minecraft Hacker
lines: I Got Hunted by a Minecraft
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: The hacker TruOriginal wrecks BAT's base and hunts Parrot, Leow0ok and Nufuli with shapeshifting and teleports. They lure him under their orbital cannon and Nufuli kills him, but The Director then has Nufuli killed.

episodes.title: SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Team
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: Toxic players blow up FlameFrags's base and kill all but one of his wolves. He hunts their leader Razor2gud from base to base, destroying his towns and surviving a TNT trap hidden under a rigged duel.

episodes.title: How I HUNTED the Unstable SMP
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu is ambushed while looting the abandoned Bounty Assassin Team base. One attacker, Wyll, befriends him, then tricks him into a void trap; Wemmbu escapes, infiltrates Wyll's crew and wipes them out.

episodes.title: How I DESTROYED the Unstable SMP
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Loppezz asks Wemmbu to win back her ice mountain from Fantst's team, who threaten to blow it up. Wemmbu fights his way in anyway; Fantst detonates the base and escapes, and Wemmbu gives loppezz netherite armour.

episodes.title: I Spent 100 Days Trapped in a Minecraft Void Base...
lines: I Spent 100 Days Trapped in a
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: SpokeIsHere sneaks invisibly into JumperWho's void base and hides there for 100 days, wrecking it and calling himself 'The Director'. Its owners, the Bounty Assassin Team, catch him, but he escapes with chorus fruit.

episodes.title: Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Doesn't Exist
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Parrot and his Bounty Assassin Team hunt the masked Director, who dares them to name him. After a falling-out with Leow0ok, Parrot learns the Director is his supposedly dead friend Wifies, and is forced to follow him.

episodes.title: SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Clan
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: Toxic players kidnap FlameFrags's wolf Ashen. He fights through base after base, each with new tricks, then beats T0X1N's commanders, survives T0X1N's attempt to execute him, kills him and frees Ashen.

episodes.title: How I SAVED the Unstable SMP
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu helps Baablu respawn the ender dragon, then learns Baablu and Fantst plan to farm dragons and destroy spawn. He teams up with MinuteTech, guardian of the End, and they fight the whole team off.

episodes.title: SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Civilization
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags battles a toxic clan led by VEN0M, a mace-wielding ex-Mafia member. With help from the farmer Lomedy, who lends him a mace and builds TNT machines, Flame destroys the clan's base and kills VEN0M.

episodes.title: How I SURVIVED a Hardcore Minecraft Tournament
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu enters AJTHEBOLD's PvP tournament for a rematch with FlameFrags. With advice from his rival Wyll, he beats Wyll and Sharpness to reach the final, where Flame outplays him and wins.

episodes.title: Dominating Minecraft's Deadliest PVP Tournament
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags enters AJTHEBOLD's PvP tournament, beating Willsion, FerreMC and Theo's explosive minecarts to reach the final, where he defeats Wemmbu and teases him about it.

episodes.title: Escaping Paragon: The Perfect Minecraft Prison
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Wifies jails Parrot in Paragon, guarded by Parrot's blackmailed friends. In a final standoff over a TNT trap, Parrot leaves behind the spyglass from their friendship; Wifies, remembering himself, dies reaching for it.

episodes.title: SOLO Player VS Minecraft Bounty Hunters
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags searches for his missing best friend Jaden_MAN, clashing with LettuceK's bounty hunters, The Law. With Leow0ok's help he tracks them down and frees Jaden, who says Wemmbu imprisoned him.

episodes.title: I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Farlands
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Sharpness steals Wemmbu's mace and flees to the Far Lands, the glitched edge of the world. Wemmbu and Eggchan chase him through strange terrain and ghostly echoes of the past, fighting him again and again.

episodes.title: I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Fartherlands
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: In the Far Lands, Wemmbu and Eggchan are hunted by 'The Avengers', a team of his old enemies. Wemmbu beats Lakerek and his orbital TNT strikes at a golden temple, then fights beside FlameFrags, who returns his mace.

episodes.title: I Got REVENGE on the Unstable SMP
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags and Jaden_MAN gather Wemmbu's old enemies to hunt him in the Far Lands, and Flame tricks Sharpness out of Wemmbu's mace. At the showdown Flame betrays the team, saves Wemmbu and returns his mace.

episodes.title: I Manipulated 1000 Players on the Unstable SMP
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: SpokeIsHere founds the Spoke Galactic Empire and raises an army of players, leading raids on Hannahxxrose and MinuteTech while dodging assassination attempts, until his army turns on him.

episodes.title: I Almost DIED on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
lines: I Almost DIED on a Hardcore
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags escapes a void trap set by LettuceK's Law, then helps Jaden_MAN rob a town for netherite. The Law hits Flame with TNT and Wardens, and Lettuce reveals Jaden set him up, but Flame survives it all.

episodes.title: I Explored to the END of the Minecraft Farlands
lines: I Explored to the END of the
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Searching the Far Lands for The Forge, a rumoured source of powerful gear, Wemmbu and Eggchan fight Firestar2008 and mace user Nitenly, cross ever stranger glitched terrain and find a city in the void.

episodes.title: Minecraft Combat Master VS Mace Pro
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags refuses Jaden_MAN's offer to join his pirates. After losing to Jaden's mace-and-trident combo in the rain, he griefs Spongs's farm for slow-falling arrows, beats Jaden and cuts him off for good.

episodes.title: I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Void
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: In the void city, Wemmbu and Eggchan loot rare gear and find orbital TNT cannons, but the locals keep The Forge from them. Their leader Serpentbound lures them to an end portal, and both are sent through it.

episodes.title: Unstable SMP: The Great Farm War
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags helps farmer Lomedy in a crop war with rival farmers Spongs and Willsion, who keep wrecking his farm. Flame finally TNT-bombs their farm, ruining them, and Lomedy rewards him with a maxed-out horse.

episodes.title: I Joined the World's Largest Minecraft Server
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Freed, Parrot finds spawn ruined by Withers and joins Theo in Capital City, ruled by greedy mayor Reddoons. They smuggle survivors in, beat Boosfer's scammers and win the city's debts forgiven.

episodes.title: I Got Betrayed by my 1000 Player Army...
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: SpokeIsHere's former army, now led by the masked 'Executive', hunts him and Mapicc, overrunning their bases. They flee through the Nether to Leow0ok's base, where Leo helps them kill the hunters.

episodes.title: Orbital Strike Cannon VS Unstable SMP
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Armed with orbital TNT cannons from the Far Lands, Wemmbu blasts through Capital City, The Law and Jaden_MAN's castle hunting FlameFrags, then finally defeats Flame at an old Mafia stash.

episodes.title: Minecraft Pro VS Orbital Strike Cannon
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: A broke FlameFrags runs errands for an invisible player who turns out to be SpokeIsHere. Spoke's last job sends him to a Mafia stash, where Wemmbu and his TNT cannons beat him and break his prized chestplate.

episodes.title: I Became Powerful on a Hardcore Minecraft Server
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: After losing to Wemmbu, FlameFrags rebuilds: he sets up a new base with Lomedy, farms experience, builds a wolf army and wipes out the Skullhound Bandits for full netherite. Then he hears Wemmbu has died.

episodes.title: The Search for Minecraft's Lost Kingdom
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Parrot and Theo follow an old trail of clues to Verdaria, a legendary hidden treasure city, dodging Boosfer's bandits. They learn ClownPierce killed its founder Verda over it, and find its huge vault.

episodes.title: Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Went Missing
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: Chasing rumours of Wemmbu's death, FlameFrags rescues Luke4472 from the Skullhound Bandits, then fights MinuteTech in the End for answers. Back home, Boosfer claims to know what happened to Wemmbu.

episodes.title: I Became a Bounty Hunter on the Unstable SMP
lines: I Became a Bounty Hunter on
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Leow0ok captures SpokeIsHere and Mapicc to try out for the Bounty Assassin Team. Spoke lies and schemes through his missions, even luring FlameFrags into a fight with Wemmbu, and gets accepted.

episodes.title: I Faked My Death on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
lines: I Faked My Death on a
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu fakes his death and goes undercover, invisible, in Capital City's guard force. He helps repel Boosfer's bandit attack, but Boosfer and Boomie learn who he is, so he vows to kill them both.

episodes.title: I Secretly Joined My Enemy's Minecraft Team
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu joins Jaden_MAN's pirates in the Great Sea to hunt Boosfer. He kills Boomie in front of Parrot to protect his secret, then kills Marine Ranger leader TheLobsterMan and gives Jaden their base.

episodes.title: The Search for Minecraft's Sunken Empire
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Parrot and Theo seek a sunken city in the Great Sea, escape the Ocean Rangers and rescue prisoner Boomie, but Theo quits. An invisible player kills Boomie to protect his identity, and Parrot vows to stop him.

episodes.title: How I "DIED" on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Still disguised, Wemmbu joins Capital City's guards to kill Boosfer, now working with FlameFrags. Their void trap fails, but Wemmbu convinces Flame that Boosfer is lying, and Boosfer flees into the Nether.

episodes.title: Hunting a Player Who Faked His Death
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags runs errands for Boosfer in return for news of Wemmbu, even shaking down Parrot for his helmet. Parrot mocks him, and after a fight with the Invisible Knight, Flame turns on Boosfer, who escapes.

episodes.title: I Escaped Minecraft's Forgotten Dimension
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu and Boosfer fall below the Nether into a hidden dimension where the Soul Keepers jail them. They team up to escape, and Wemmbu spares Boosfer in exchange for keeping his identity secret.

episodes.title: I Infiltrated Minecraft's Deadliest Faction
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: In the Nether to kill its ruler ClownPierce, FlameFrags allies with Parrot and Theo and kidnaps FerreMC. Hearing Parrot is using him, Flame sides with Clown, then turns on him to save them both.

episodes.title: The Hunt for Minecraft's Deadliest Vault
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Parrot and Theo slip into ClownPierce's Nether festival to find his secret vault, allying with FlameFrags. Flame betrays them, then saves them; Parrot loots the vault and agrees to find out what happened to Wemmbu.

episodes.title: 100% Invisibility Exploit VS Hardcore SMP
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Using a true-invisibility glitch, SpokeIsHere and Mapicc prank new player JackLive_XD and war with griefer ApexPoint's team. Spoke tricks ApexPoint into a dripstone trap, and they kill him and ZeroCycle for good.

episodes.title: This Player Stole My Identity
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu hunts two players copying his invisible disguise. They lure him into a sealed courtroom trap, where he unmasks them as Theo and Parrot, then crafts ladders to glitch his way out.

episodes.title: 100 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: LettuceK's Law recruits 100 fighters to make FlameFrags surrender. Disguised with Lomedy, Flame steals their gear shipment, then crushes Lettuce's army, explaining he hunts Wemmbu to prove skill beats power.

episodes.title: The Search for Wemmbu
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: ParrotX2 teams up with FlameFrags to prove the mysterious Invisible Knight is Wemmbu, who faked his death. After impersonating him and laying traps, Parrot lures him into a TNT dome whose blast exposes Wemmbu's name in chat.

episodes.title: I Got Hunted By Minecraft's Smartest Player
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu, secretly living as the Invisible Knight, is chased through traps by ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird until a TNT blast reveals who he is. He knocks Parrot into the void, and FlameFrags demands a rematch.

episodes.title: Exposing a Player Who Faked His Death
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags unmasks the Invisible Knight as Wemmbu, but LettuceK's police force, the LAW, keeps ambushing their duel. The rivals team up and agree to fight Lettuce's whole army; if they win, the LAW leaves them alone.

episodes.title: I Trapped Secret Bases on the Unstable SMP...
lines: I Trapped Secret Bases on the
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: SpokeIsHere secretly kills players in their hidden bases with traps, then kills the spies tailing him, while Mapicc covers for him with Leow0ok. The loot pays debts for Quackenstein123's family, as JumperWho's spies watch.

episodes.title: 2 VS 1000 Player Minecraft War
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags and Wemmbu take on LettuceK's 1,000-player LAW army, wiping it out with TNT minecarts and maces. Flame then turns on Wemmbu and forces him to admit Flame is the strongest, while Lettuce hints at a bigger plan.

episodes.title: 2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu and FlameFrags rob players for supplies, then destroy LettuceK's army of thousands of lawmen. Flame turns on Wemmbu, who gives up the title of strongest player, and Lettuce takes the worn-out Wemmbu prisoner.

episodes.title: Finding the Tomb of the Minecraft Mafia
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: ParrotX2 and Theo hunt for the Invisible Mafia's treasure tomb in the End, evading its invisible guardian Marlowww. Her journals show she is protecting others, so Parrot leaves the stash untouched and quits treasure hunting.

episodes.title: I Got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Stalkers...
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: SpokeIsHere kills spies from BAT, the assassin team investigating him, and infiltrates their archive disguised as one. He frames a stranger with stolen armor, but BAT leader Leow0ok threatens the family Spoke supports.

episodes.title: I Got Banished from a Hardcore Minecraft Server
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: LettuceK, leader of the LAW, calls for an elected king and turns the server against FlameFrags. Flame saves his friend Lomedy but is beaten by Lettuce's hidden netherite army, and goes into exile vowing to master combat.

episodes.title: I Became a Prisoner on the Unstable SMP
lines: I Became a Prisoner on the
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu is jailed in LettuceK's prison with Baablu and Fantst. A failed escape sends him to solitary, where SpokeIsHere offers to free him in return for using his orbital strike cannons (TNT super-weapons); Wemmbu refuses.

episodes.title: Unstable SMP: The First King
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Guided by notes from a mysterious 'Owl', ParrotX2 and Theo rescue a hostage from the Phantom bandits and defend remote Treebo Village. The grateful villagers' votes make Parrot a candidate in LettuceK's king election.

episodes.title: I Got Hunted on the World's Largest Minecraft Server
lines: I Got Hunted on the World's
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: In exile, FlameFrags practises a new wind-charge pearl technique at Lomedy's farm and fights off LAW officers led by Deputy_Ace. Lomedy surrenders to the LAW to save Flame, who sets out to find people to train him.

episodes.title: Escaping Prison on the Unstable SMP
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu and fellow prisoners PrinceZam, Baablu and Fantst keep trying to escape the LAW's prison. Facing execution, he accepts SpokeIsHere's deal, breaks out, and heads to the Far Lands to rebuild his orbital strike cannons.

episodes.title: I Almost Got BANNED from the Unstable SMP...
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: After BAT blows up the home of the family he supports, SpokeIsHere breaks Wemmbu out of the LAW's prison to help him kill BAT leader Leow0ok. The ambush fails, and Leo escapes having finally caught Spoke in the act.

episodes.title: I Got Hunted By the Minecraft LAW
lines: I Got Hunted By the Minecraft
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: On the run from the LAW, Wemmbu finds allies in the End with MinuteTech and Eggchan and helps SpokeIsHere's failed attack on Leow0ok. Cornered by Deputy_Ace's lawmen, he is rescued by Jaden_MAN's Pirates.

episodes.title: I Secretly Got Trained By My Minecraft Killer
lines: I Secretly Got Trained By My
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: Hidden by invisibility and a voice changer, FlameFrags trains under Swight, the world's third-best PvP fighter. He outlasts rival students like Yungy, beats two elite bandits alone, and becomes Swight's partner.

episodes.title: I Joined a PIRATE CIVILIZATION in Minecraft
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu and Eggchan join the Pirates and search the Great Sea for a collector whose music discs the LAW needs to aim a giant cannon. They find him, but LettuceK steals the discs and kills him.

episodes.title: My Best Friend Died on the Unstable SMP
lines: My Best Friend Died on the
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: When Leow0ok claims he killed Mapicc, SpokeIsHere nearly blows up Capitol City until ParrotX2 talks him down. He finds Mapicc alive with old friend JamatoP, then secretly drives Jamato off and stages his death.

episodes.title: I Ran for King on the Unstable SMP
lines: I Ran for King on the Unstable
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: In LettuceK's king election, ParrotX2 learns the Owl is lawman Spepticle, then reveals in a debate that Wemmbu escaped. Spepticle is executed taking the blame for Parrot, and Lettuce plots to have rival candidates kill Parrot.

episodes.title: I Secretly Teamed With My Minecraft Killer
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: Still disguised, FlameFrags joins the mercenary Swight on jobs defending villages from bandits while learning new PvP skills. When the LAW reveals Flame is Swight's target, Flame buys his freedom with a vault full of loot.

episodes.title: Unstable SMP: The Battle for The Great Sea
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: The LAW finishes a giant orbital cannon aimed at the Pirates' city, and LettuceK blasts Wemmbu far out to sea. Re-armed by the hermit Linnwyrm, he returns with Eggchan and destroys the cannon, though Jaden is captured.

episodes.title: I Got Trained By a Minecraft Spear Master
lines: I Got Trained By a Minecraft
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags tracks down his estranged old teammate ManePear to learn the new spear weapon. After Mane abandons him to the LAW and then breaks him out of prison, the two wipe out a LAW army and raid its vault.

episodes.title: I Survived the Unstable SMP Purge
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: LettuceK declares 'The Purge', 24 hours in which candidates may attack each other for vote books. ParrotX2 refuses to fight dirty and rescues Horace and Fymada, who back him in return, putting him in the final four.

episodes.title: I Got Trained By the World's Best Minecraft Player
lines: I Got Trained By the World's
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags trains with retired PvP legend ItzRealMe, learning advanced mace tricks and 'the zone', a state of total focus. He wipes out a LAW patrol, then wins a final duel against Itz.

episodes.title: Breaking Hardcore Minecraft to Get Revenge
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Using game-breaking exploits, SpokeIsHere, Mapicc and PrinceZam destroy a village, then fight off Leow0ok's LAW soldiers at their sky base. Leo teleports away, and someone else then triggers Spoke's own secret escape pearl.

episodes.title: 2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Hunters
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: ParrotX2 fetches Wemmbu from the Great Sea to prove LettuceK lost his prisoner. Dodging the LAW across its territory, they burst into the final-four debate, but Lettuce holds Theo hostage to force Parrot to back him.

episodes.title: I Became a Minecraft Killer
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu reluctantly travels with ParrotX2, the man who exposed him, through LAW territory as Eggchan secretly shadows them. He spares Parrot, appears at LettuceK's debate, then launches himself to the Far Lands.

episodes.title: I Explored the Minecraft Farlands
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu and Eggchan trick JamatoP into guiding them across the Far Lands, the world's corrupted edge, then turn on him. After fighting off locals Nitenly and Serpentbound, he reloads his orbital strikes and heads for the End.

episodes.title: I Got Trained By a Minecraft TNT Master
lines: I Got Trained By a Minecraft
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags asks TheobaldTheBird to teach him TNT minecart combat. After losing a duel to LAW commander TheG0dofWar, Flame masters carting and beats him in a rematch, now counting himself a combat master.

episodes.title: Minecraft Trapper VS 1000 Players
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: SpokeIsHere dares the server to come for him and turns trap-filled biomes against Leow0ok's LAW army. Ex-BAT spymaster JumperWho keeps saving him, and after Leo's railguns blast their base, Spoke accepts her alliance.

episodes.title: Minecraft Pro VS 1000 Players
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu and Eggchan escape the LAW-occupied End with MinuteTech's help, then Wemmbu wipes out LettuceK's army at the Northern Council with orbital strikes. Lettuce stops him by threatening to kill his captive ally Jaden_MAN.

episodes.title: I Became King of the Unstable SMP
lines: I Became King of the Unstable
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Jailed by self-declared king LettuceK, ParrotX2 escapes with help from Deputy_Ace, who dies saving him and Theo. Parrot's alliance with Spoke, Wemmbu and Flame then crushes the LAW, and he is elected king.

episodes.title: 4 Minecraft Pros VS 2500 Players
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: SpokeIsHere and JumperWho raid LAW prisons, freeing spies and Jaden_MAN and recruiting Wemmbu and Flame, then join ParrotX2's army to defeat LettuceK. Spoke then corners Leow0ok, whose escape pearl drops him into the void.

episodes.title: Unstable SMP: The LAW
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Asked by JumperWho to save Jaden_MAN from execution, Wemmbu teams up with FlameFrags to wreck the LAW's headquarters. He joins ParrotX2's alliance, helps defeat LettuceK, and casts the vote that spares Lettuce's life.

episodes.title: 2500 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags teams up with old rival Wemmbu to storm the LAW's prison, then reluctantly joins former enemies in ParrotX2's army to defeat LettuceK. Afterwards he frees his friend Lomedy and returns his mace.

episodes.title: I Joined a 100,000 Player Minecraft Server
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Now living peacefully, Wemmbu agrees to recover a lost mace for a village. He wins a 4v4 tournament with Eggchan and Jaden_MAN to learn where its tomb is, then fights off an invisible rival who grabs it first.

episodes.title: I Became a Minecraft Combat Master
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: Aiming to become a combat 'grandmaster' with no weaknesses, FlameFrags rebuilds his base with Lomedy, helped by lawmen and pranksters Spongs and Willsion. When Arachn1d's gang attacks, he repels it with his wolf cannon.

episodes.title: 100 Days as King of the Unstable SMP
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Newly crowned, ParrotX2 vows to make spawn safe within 100 days or resign. He and Theo clear spawn's withers, make Fymada mayor of Capitol City and win a prized chicken to feed the server, yet many players still resent him.

episodes.title: Minecraft Trapper VS Elite Bounty Hunters
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Seeking the missing Mapicc, SpokeIsHere is hunted by NULL, skinless bounty hunters who seem unkillable. With JumperWho he traces the bounty to SirPig_ and kills their leader with an arrow railgun.

episodes.title: I Joined the Minecraft LAW
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: To pay off a 100-day debt for the base the LAW built him, FlameFrags serves as a LAW elite with Lomedy and Spongs, battling Arachn1d's gang. He refuses to join Arachn1d's new kingdom and visits the jailed LettuceK.

episodes.title: Minecraft Pro VS 1000 Player Civilization
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: When a 1,000-player army kidnaps his best friend Eggchan, Wemmbu trails it to the underground Sculk Kingdom, beats its leader driftop99 in a duel, routs Yungyx's army and frees Egg.

episodes.title: I Exposed a Corrupt Minecraft Civilization
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Framed for 43 murders in Capitol City, King Parrot is jailed by a corrupt police force. DanchoGold's guards free him, and with Theo and Fymada he exposes the police plot to purge new players.

episodes.title: Searching for 100 Players Who Went Missing
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Hunting for his missing best friend Mapicc, Spoke and JumperWho follow a book of coordinates while fleeing NULL, bounty hunters who abduct 'bad' players. At the end, Mapicc turns up at their door.

episodes.title: I Explored the Minecraft Mist
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: Hired to assassinate Mistrul, the feared enforcer of the hidden Mist civilization, FlameFrags infiltrates the Mist, brings in his friend Lomedy and duels Mistrul. As they flee, Lomedy is shot off their ghast.

episodes.title: Searching for a Civilization that Doesn't Exist
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Parrot and Theo search for the 1,000 vanished settlers of Skymore and follow Zoe's clues east. They learn the old-player kingdom Cindercrest and its killer ShoeBilly took them, and survivor Reina joins Parrot.

episodes.title: Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Mapicc leads Spoke and Jumper 12 million blocks out into the Far Lands, the glitched edge of the world, to find NULL's captives. Deep underground they meet JamatoP, an old friend thought dead, who offers help.

episodes.title: 1000 Players Simulate MIST War in Minecraft
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: Searching the Mist for Lomedy, FlameFrags is betrayed by Flowtives and told his friend is dead. Grief-stricken, he kills Mistrul in a duel, then finds Lomedy alive and hiding.

episodes.title: I Got Hunted by the World's Deadliest Assassin
lines: I Got Hunted by the World's
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: An invisible assassin, the Wraith, wants Eggchan dead. Wemmbu interrogates hired bandits, is caught in a flying machine, escapes with Parrot's help and kills the assassin, then sees an identical one appear.

episodes.title: I Created the World's Largest Minecraft Army
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: With Cindercrest about to invade, Parrot builds an army: he recruits bandits, takes DanchoGold hostage to win Merchant City's guards, buys TNT from ClownPierce and blows up The LAW's holdouts.

episodes.title: Finding 1000 Players Who Went Missing
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Spoke finds Jamato is NULL's leader and blackmailing him, but his botched attempt to kill Jamato turns Mapicc and Jumper against him. Jamato captures Mapicc and makes Spoke burn his gear.

episodes.title: Searching For My Friend Who Went Missing
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu teams up with the invisible assassin to find a kidnapped Eggchan, then learns the assassin has him. An auction for Egg becomes a brawl, and Arachn1d tells Wemmbu to join his caves or Egg dies.

episodes.title: I Joined a 10,000 Player Minecraft Army
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags reluctantly joins Cindercrest, the old players' rebel kingdom, to protect Lomedy. He helps take Fort Feather and kidnaps Eggchan to find Wemmbu's cannons, but loses him and walks into a trap at Merchant City.

episodes.title: Unstable SMP: Civil War
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Civil war: Parrot loses Fort Feather to Cindercrest's blimp and wins Merchant City with an arrow-cannon trap. Then he loses Highwater City, the kingdom's food source, as Saparata rallies the old players.

episodes.title: 1000 Players Simulate UNDERGROUND Civilization in Minecraft
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Forced into Arachn1d's underground kingdom to save Eggchan, Wemmbu starts with wooden tools beside Jaden. He rises from miner to royalty through raids and an assassination, then spares Parrot in battle.

episodes.title: 1000 Players Simulate PRISON in Hardcore Minecraft
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Locked in Purgatory, NULL's Nether prison, Spoke trades in its black market, fights as a gladiator and escapes solitary to expose Jamato as the prison's master, though he, Mapicc and Jumper stay imprisoned.

episodes.title: I Went to WAR on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
lines: I Went to WAR on a Hardcore
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: On Arachn1d's orders, Wemmbu duels ShoeBilly and FlameFrags, then betrays Cindercrest at Capitol City, killing hundreds with his orbital TNT cannons. Instead of freeing Egg, Arachn1d drops Wemmbu into a trap.

episodes.title: 1000 VS 1000 Player Minecraft Civil War
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags helps Cindercrest win Highwater but sees Saparata sacrifice his own men. He and Lomedy switch to Parrot's side, survive Wemmbu's massacre at Capitol City, and then Lomedy leaves him.

episodes.title: Unstable SMP: Civil War FINALE
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Parrot trades a prisoner to get Reina back and gains Flame and Lomedy, but Wemmbu's orbital strikes wreck Capitol City. Saparata reveals he'll kill every new player, beats Parrot at spawn and crowns himself king.

episodes.title: 1000 Players Simulate THE PURGE in Minecraft
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Arachn1d drops his whole kingdom into the Purge, a free-for-all arena. Wemmbu teams with Yungyx, Jaden, Codmaster and Egg, crafts a mace and wins through, then vows to kill Arachn1d when Egg is snatched again.

episodes.title: I Became the Strongest on the Unstable SMP
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: To prove he's the strongest, FlameFrags guards the stasis pearls holding Eggchan prisoner, which forces Wemmbu to fight him. Wemmbu gives up mid-duel, Flame hands over the pearls, and they promise a real fight later.

episodes.title: 1000 Players Simulate HUNGER GAMES in Hardcore Minecraft
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Jamato forces Purgatory's prisoners into a Hunger Games. Spoke and Mapicc fight through it and lose DylPickle to Jamato's bribe. Spoke only pretends to leave by pearl cannon, and a NULL commander offers to help him.

episodes.title: I Got Hunted By the World's Deadliest Minecraft Player
lines: I Got Hunted By the World's
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: As FlameFrags rebuilds his base using The LAW's help and LettuceK's old stashes, rival TheG0DofWar keeps hunting him for a rematch. Flame wins, spares him, and asks G0dofWar to train him.

episodes.title: Unstable SMP: Purgatory
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Secretly helped by a NULL commander, Spoke raises a rebel army in the arena and fights Jamato for the Totem of NULL, which controls NULL. He knocks Mapicc into the void, takes the totem and becomes NULL's leader.

episodes.title: I Got Trained By a Minecraft Combat Master (Warriors Arc)
lines: I Got Trained By a Minecraft
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: TheG0DofWar trains FlameFrags as they fight through arena champions to retake his old base from Antaggg's warriors. G0dofWar is killed, and Antaggg uses dirty tricks to claim victory over Flame.

episodes.title: Minecraft's Best Players Simulate PVP Tournament
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags enters Antaggg's PvP tournament to avenge G0dofWar and wins every round with Falconu's help. He loses the final duel to Antaggg, who Falconu reveals was secretly swapping in other players.

episodes.title: 1000 Players Build END Civilization in Hardcore Minecraft
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Leading NULL, Spoke conquers the End: he defeats its guardian and old friend MinuteTech, forces Jamato to build wither cannons and destroys villages for the end crystals needed to escape the End.

episodes.title: I Built Minecraft's Most Advanced Civilization
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Exiled, Parrot founds a jungle civilization with PestoPasta2009 and cures a rare villager. Totem-duplicating machines beat Saparata's attack, but Pesto dies saving the villager and ClownPierce seizes Parrot.

episodes.title: I Created Minecraft's Greatest Military
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Spoke leads NULL into the Overworld to seize the end portals. He faces invisible attackers and Jamato's warning of a greater threat, and wrecks the Vael Company when JumperWho begs him to give up NULL.

episodes.title: I Exposed Minecraft's "Strongest" Player
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: FlameFrags and Falconu defend the Canary civilization from Antaggg's warriors, surviving ambushes and an arrow cannon. Flame finally tracks down Antaggg's hidden stasis, forces a fair duel and beats him.

episodes.title: How I Destroyed an Entire Minecraft Civilization
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: Wemmbu sets out to free Eggchan by destroying the many stasis pearls Arachn1d uses to hold him. With Yungyx, Jaden and Flame he topples Arachn1d and saves Egg, then loses the kingdom to Yungyx in a duel.

episodes.title: 1000 Players Simulate Mining Prison in Minecraft
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Imprisoned in ClownPierce's Nether mining prison, Parrot mines ancient debris to survive. Fellow escapee SnowLicker betrays him and his friends die, but Parrot leads the prisoners down a void hole into the Underworld.

episodes.title: Exploring Minecraft’s Forgotten Dimension
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Seeking to decode Jamato's 'Tomb' book, Spoke enters the Underworld and solves puzzle dungeons with a hostile Mapicc. At the Citadel library he hears the scholars' warnings, then escapes and leaves Mapicc trapped.

episodes.title: Searching for a Vault that Doesn't Exist
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: Cloudwatch_ hires FlameFrags and NotSkrilley to find Windgrove's lost vault. After racing a rival Resistance group through traps, Cloud reveals there is no vault: it's a trap to kill overpowered players like Flame.

episodes.title: How I Saved the World's Largest Minecraft Server
episodes.creator: Wemmbu
episodes.summary: With Saparata's bounty on his head, Wemmbu refuses to join Spoke and races to protect his orbital cannons in the Far Lands. NULL destroys them and kills Jaden, and Wemmbu and Egg flee into the Underworld.

episodes.title: I Created Minecraft's Greatest Empire
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Spoke tries to recruit Wemmbu, then hunts him across the Far Lands with NULL, and the orbital cannons are destroyed. In a hidden city, Ashswagg, the Invisible Mafia's old leader, tells Spoke he is becoming him.

episodes.title: Escaping the Minecraft Underworld
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: Trapped in the Underworld with a thousand ex-prisoners and unable to place blocks, Parrot leads them through mazes, wardens and traps, losing nearly all. He escapes alone, only for NULL to capture him.

episodes.title: Escaping Terminus: The Deadliest Minecraft Prison
episodes.creator: FlameFrags
episodes.summary: Trapped in Terminus, Cindercrest's prison for the strongest players, FlameFrags and Skrilley endure TNT, wardens and Cloudwatch's traps and refuse LettuceK's offer to join Cindercrest until The LAW breaks Flame out.

episodes.title: 1000 Players Simulate End Prison in Minecraft
episodes.creator: ParrotX2
episodes.summary: In NULL's five-floor End prison, Parrot wins duels, is trained by MinuteTech and cracks a door code, then wins the last round when Minute yields. Spoke, who built the prison, asks Parrot to join him, and Parrot refuses.

episodes.title: 10,000 Players Simulate COLD WAR in Minecraft
episodes.creator: SpokeIsHere
episodes.summary: Fresh from conquering the Far Lands, Spoke is driven from NULL's capital by ClownPierce's Nether Kingdom. He raids rival civilizations for resources, agrees with Clown that neither will invade the Overworld, and frees an enslaved mining civilization whose army helps NULL retake the capital.

majors.name: Spoke destroys the Wonders
majors.full: Spoke's orbital cannon destroys the Wonders
majors.desc: SpokeIsHere and JamatoP find that long-patched Minecraft glitches work again, and Spoke hides his exploit machines inside five grand builds, the Wonders, guarded by Wemmbu and others. When Wemmbu starts snooping, Spoke fires an orbital cannon (a giant TNT cannon striking from the sky) to destroy the evidence. ParrotX2 races to build his own cannon to stop it, but all five Wonders fall, and Spoke and Wemmbu become enemies.

majors.name: Battle of Stasis
majors.desc: The Invisible Mafia controls its members through stasis chambers (stored ender pearls rigged to drop their owners into the void). After Ashswagg kills Wifies, ParrotX2 directs the strike: Spoke and Mapicc dive into the Mafia's hidden chamber and mine out every pearl while Wemmbu and Eggchan distract ClownPierce. Freed, Mafia members drink milk to turn visible. The Mafia collapses, ending Season 1's war; fans date the timeline from this day.

majors.name: Final battle vs. the LAW
majors.desc: LettuceK, head of the LAW police force, abandons the election he was losing and crowns himself king. Parrot escapes his prison, and Spoke, Wemmbu and FlameFrags, longtime rivals, raid LAW HQ to free their friends and join him. Parrot leads District 13 into Northern Council, where Wemmbu's orbital strikes wipe out most of the army and a hidden netherite legion is beaten. Lettuce flees the battle, then later comes back and surrenders himself. A 6–5 vote keeps him alive, and he is imprisoned, ending the LAW's rule.

majors.name: Final Battle of Capitol City
majors.desc: In the war between Parrot's kingdom and Saparata's Cindercrest, FlameFrags quits Cindercrest and joins Parrot to stop Saparata recruiting at Capitol City. But Wemmbu, secretly ordered by Arachn1d (Cindercrest's ally, who holds Eggchan captive) to betray everyone, rains orbital strikes on the city, killing hundreds on both sides. Parrot's own army turns on him, Saparata takes the crown, and Parrot flees, overthrown and exiled.

events.name: Wemmbu teams with PrinceZam's Zam Empire to kill Spoke
events.short: Wemmbu joins the Zam Empire to hunt Spoke
events.desc: After escaping SpokeIsHere's vault trap, Wemmbu is jumped by ManePear and FlameFrags, guards of PrinceZam's Zam Empire, who are also hunting Spoke. He agrees to team with PrinceZam to kill Spoke, and together they chunk-ban (trap with a disconnecting glitch) Spoke's henchmen. It's Wemmbu's first faction.

events.name: Spoke burns down TheRealSquiddo's castle while destroying duped items
events.short: Spoke burns down Squiddo's castle hunting duped items
events.desc: After wrecking the Wonders, Spoke and Mapicc hunt down every duped (glitch-copied) item spread across the server. At TheRealSquiddo's base Spoke sets a pile of duped netherite blocks on fire, and the flames spread until her whole castle burns down.

events.name: Spoke chunk-bans Wifies after the chess game, then bans himself with him
events.short: Spoke chunk-bans Wifies, then himself
events.desc: Spoke lures ParrotX2 and his friend Wifies through a scavenger hunt for a 'server secret'. It's revenge: the final chess game sends the loser into a chunk ban, and Wifies steps in when it ends in a stalemate. Cornered by Wemmbu and PrinceZam, Spoke then chunk-bans himself alongside Wifies.

events.name: Parrot breaks Wifies and Spoke out of the chunk-ban prisons
events.short: Parrot breaks Wifies out of the chunk-ban prison
events.desc: To free Wifies, Parrot and rekrap2 break into PrinceZam's chunk-ban prisons one by one, freeing Derapchu, Fantst and JumperWho. With escape expert _Kenadian_, they chunk-ban the guards and blast open the prison holding Wifies, accidentally freeing Spoke too.

events.name: Wemmbu founds the Wemmbu Civilization
events.short: Wemmbu founds the Wemmbu Civilization
events.desc: PrinceZam asks Wemmbu to build a colony guarding a vault she owns, telling him never to look inside. With his friend Eggchan and builder Horace_Altman, Wemmbu grows it into the Wemmbu Civilization, his first base of his own, fending off raids from FlameFrags and Jaden_MAN.

events.name: Ashswagg first appears and offers to team with Spoke
events.short: Spoke meets Ashswagg
events.desc: While Spoke and Mapicc tour the server's farms to cut off Roshambogames's riches, a friendly stranger, Ashswagg, offers to team up. Mapicc distrusts him, but Spoke hands over the farm coordinates, and Ashswagg secretly blows the farms up. He will become Season 1's main villain.

events.name: PrinceZam's Zam Empire destroys the Wemmbu Civilization
events.short: Zam Empire destroys the Wemmbu Civilization
events.desc: Wemmbu finds PrinceZam's vault is an empty obsidian box, and FlameFrags turns out to be secretly working for her. Zam then destroys Wemmbu's civilization, saying he's too weak to be a threat. Parrot, who had sheltered there from ClownPierce, finds it in ruins. Wemmbu swears revenge on the Zam Empire.

events.name: Wemmbu and Egg bomb Spoke's End base
events.short: Wemmbu and Egg bomb Spoke's End base
events.desc: Broke after losing his civilization, Wemmbu and Eggchan start selling griefing services. Roshambogames pays them to blow up Spoke's End base, and they succeed, catching Spoke and Mapicc by surprise. It's a paid job with no lasting consequences, but the first time their paths cross since the vault.

events.name: Wemmbu, Parrot and Wifies orbital-strike and rob the Treasure Hunters' HQ
events.short: Wemmbu and Parrot orbital-strike the Treasure Hunters
events.desc: Boosfer's Treasure Hunters keep stealing the prized items of Parrot's missing friends, and hire Wemmbu to bomb a valley. Wemmbu teams with Parrot and Wifies instead; they build an orbital strike cannon (a giant TNT cannon that hits from the sky) and wreck the Treasure Hunters' headquarters, looting its vault.

events.name: Wemmbu destroys the Zam Empire
events.short: Wemmbu destroys the Zam Empire
events.desc: After the Zam Empire bombs his rebuilt colony and captures Eggchan, Wemmbu lets himself be imprisoned, smuggles in gear and frees Egg. When PrinceZam lowers the obsidian shield over her empire, he fires his orbital cannon and nukes it, completing his revenge and ending the PrinceZam Empire Arc.

events.name: ClownPierce imprisons Wemmbu and PrinceZam in Proton
events.short: ClownPierce imprisons Wemmbu in Proton
events.desc: Moments after the Zam Empire falls, ClownPierce kidnaps both Wemmbu and PrinceZam and locks them in Proton, a walled-off mini world used as a high-security prison. Forced together with only a few totems, the old enemies alternate between fighting and uneasy truces.

events.name: Wemmbu escapes Proton and smuggles in the contraband for Parrot's breakout
events.short: Wemmbu and Parrot break out of Proton
events.desc: Using _Kenadian_'s ender pearl cannon, Wemmbu alone launches out of Proton, leaving Eggchan behind. He comes back in through a stasis chamber (a stored ender pearl that teleports its owner) carrying contraband, and Parrot's group breaks out. Kenadian stays behind but leaves a way to pull her out.

events.name: The Mafia overruns Parrot's End civilization
events.short: The Mafia overruns Parrot's End civilization
events.desc: Parrot and Wifies found a hidden civilization deep in the End, recruiting Mafia defector Deanthebean9 and beating Boosfer in an election for leader. But a mole switches off the chunk-ban defenses and the Invisible Mafia, a faction of invisible players, invades. Parrot blows up the civilization himself.

events.name: Ashswagg frames Spoke and Mapicc; the Invisible Mafia hunts them
events.short: Spoke uncovers the Invisible Mafia
events.desc: Ashswagg reveals he framed Spoke and Mapicc for destroying the server's farms. His invisible players are the Invisible Mafia, which now hunts them. Helped by ex-member MinuteTech, they keep escaping, but Mapicc is captured and Spoke learns all his old exploits have been patched.

events.name: Reddoons hands Parrot's group to Ashswagg and the Mafia
events.short: Reddoons hands Parrot to the Mafia
events.desc: Caught robbing Capital City, Parrot, Wifies and Dean are forced to mine diamond quotas for its ruler Reddoons, who rigs a deadly game to kill their friend LuigiToan. Reddoons then hands the trio to Ashswagg, who tries to force them into the Mafia, but a sympathetic warden, CoinMonke, helps them escape.

events.name: Spoke infiltrates the Invisible Mafia
events.short: Spoke infiltrates the Invisible Mafia
events.desc: Following JamatoP's last clues, Spoke teams up with PlanetLord and Leow0ok and goes undercover inside the Mafia's city, which ranks members by armor tiers. He rescues Mapicc and climbs the ranks by completing missions, even killing an innocent player, iMajesticRose, to keep his cover.

events.name: Spoke and Mapicc, as Mafia, chase Parrot's group at a trial chamber
events.short: Spoke, as Mafia, chases Parrot at a trial chamber
events.desc: Parrot, Wifies and Dean flee across the server and loot a trial chamber, hearing other players nearby. They are Spoke's undercover Mafia group, tasked with killing Parrot, though Spoke deliberately fails the mission. Parrot's group mines out and escapes without learning who it was.

events.name: Yeah_Jaron gives Wemmbu a mace; the Mafia destroys Sky Civilization
events.short: Wemmbu gets a mace; the Mafia destroys Sky Civilization
events.desc: Forced into the secretive Skyblock Civilization, Wemmbu gets a mace (a rare smash-attack weapon) from leader Yeah_Jaron, then exposes Jaron for hoarding items that shouldn't exist there. Enforcer Straight turns out to be with the Mafia, who destroys the city. Wemmbu leaves with a mace and a Mafia grudge.

events.name: deanthebean9 confesses he has led the Mafia to Parrot's group
events.short: Deanthebean9 confesses he's the Mafia's tracker
events.desc: Near the end of their Far Lands trek, Deanthebean9 admits he has been the reason the Mafia found Parrot's group every time. Dean leaves, Wifies burns the compass guiding them, and Parrot continues alone.

events.name: Elytra deal at the old Zam Empire; Egg revealed as Mafia
events.short: Elytra deal with Spoke; Egg unmasked as Mafia
events.desc: Spoke, still undercover, needs elytra for a Mafia mission, so he makes a deal with Wemmbu: Wemmbu helps find elytra in the ruined Zam Empire, and Spoke helps him track Mafia members. There Wemmbu pops an invisible player's totem and discovers it's his missing friend Eggchan, now in the Mafia.

events.name: FlameFrags holds Egg hostage and takes Wemmbu's mace
events.short: Flame takes Wemmbu's mace for Egg's life
events.desc: After ManePear betrays Eggchan to the Mafia, Wemmbu tries to rescue him and unmasks a diamond-tier member: FlameFrags. Flame threatens to kill Egg unless Wemmbu hands over his mace, wins their duel, and gives the mace to ClownPierce. This starts the long Wemmbu-Flame rivalry.

events.name: Spoke's totem pops in the diamond duel, unmasking him to Ashswagg
events.short: Ashswagg unmasks Spoke inside the Mafia
events.desc: To reach diamond rank, Spoke must duel a diamond player Ashswagg picks. When Spoke's totem pops, his disguise falls away and Ashswagg sees who he really is. His opponent, MinuteTech, sides with Spoke, but Ashswagg escapes by stasis chamber. Spoke's infiltration is over and his war with Ashswagg is open.

events.name: Parrot becomes leader of the Far Lands civilization
events.short: Parrot becomes leader of the Far Lands civilization
events.desc: Arriving alone at Horace_Altman's Far Lands city, Parrot joins its Warriors faction and wins a council seat by duel. When leader Purpled tries to have him killed, the council votes Purpled out and makes Parrot leader, and he unites the Warriors with the Farmers. It's his first real leadership.

events.name: The Mafia destroys the Far Lands civilization; District 13 is founded
events.short: Mafia razes the Far Lands city; District 13 founded
events.desc: Ashswagg's Mafia destroys the Far Lands civilization. Horace and the five other survivors form District 13, a hidden bunker and the last resistance against the Mafia, with Parrot and Wifies among its members.

events.name: Parrot, Wifies, Spoke and Mapicc team up against the Mafia at spawn
events.short: Parrot and Spoke team up against the Mafia
events.desc: At spawn, Parrot and Wifies run into Spoke and Mapicc, who reveal Spoke infiltrated the Mafia. They agree to work together to end it, following leads to the Mafia's diamond-tier member Quackenstein, who hands over a book pointing to the Mafia's stasis chambers, the tool it uses to control its members.

events.name: Horace and District 13 defect to the Mafia; Wifies joins the Mafia to protect Parrot
events.short: District 13 defects; Wifies joins the Mafia for Parrot
events.desc: District 13 falls apart: Horace joins the Mafia, others defect or leave, until only Parrot and Wifies remain. When Ashswagg finds their hideout and orders them to join within minutes, Wifies joins the Mafia himself to buy Parrot time and gather information.

events.name: Spawn prison break-in; Parrot recruits Wemmbu
events.short: Spawn prison break-in
events.desc: Parrot asks Wemmbu, now out to kill ClownPierce, to join District 13; Wemmbu helps only long enough to win a mace, then leaves. He returns to distract the guards while Parrot, Spoke and Mapicc break into the Mafia's spawn prison and follow the new recruits' pearls toward the hidden stasis chambers.

events.name: Ashswagg kills Wifies in front of Parrot
events.short: Ashswagg kills Wifies in front of Parrot
events.desc: Ashswagg confronts Parrot at his and Wifies's house and demands he join the Mafia. When Parrot refuses, Ash pulls Wifies's stasis chamber and kills him in front of Parrot. Afterwards, Ash claims a mysterious player called 'The Director' was the one responsible.

events.name: Wemmbu and Eggchan found the Eggchan Empire at ManePear's old treehouse
events.short: Wemmbu and Egg found the Eggchan Empire
events.desc: After the Mafia falls, Wemmbu and Eggchan settle at ManePear's old treehouse and build a small empire, with Horace_Altman improving it and Wemmbu raiding other players for experience bottles to pay new citizens. It's a fresh start, but Jaden_MAN's pirates are already circling.

events.name: Jaden destroys the Eggchan Empire and exiles Wemmbu to his Pirate Civilization
events.short: Jaden exiles Wemmbu to the Pirate Civilization
events.desc: Pirate leader Jaden_MAN takes Eggchan hostage and forces Wemmbu to drop all his gear, then destroys the empire and exiles him to his lawless Pirate Islands. Wemmbu must scavenge, free Egg and fight his way out, starting his feud with Jaden.

events.name: Parrot joins the Bounty Assassin Team
events.short: Parrot joins the Bounty Assassin Team
events.desc: The fighter ItzRealMe is hired to assassinate Parrot. Leow0ok's bounty hunter team, the Bounty Assassin Team (BAT), saves him and invites him in. ItzRealMe reveals the hit was ordered by 'The Director', the same name Ashswagg blamed for Wifies's death, opening the Director Arc.

events.name: Spoke spies inside Ashswagg's secret base
events.short: Spoke hides inside Ashswagg's secret base
events.desc: Spoke sees Ashswagg slip into a secret base and secretly moves in, living hidden inside it for 100 days. He spies on Ashswagg and TheRealSquiddo, steals their loot and sabotages a trade, until Ashswagg reveals he gave the Dragon Egg to Reddoons, sending Spoke after it.

events.name: Wemmbu robs Loppezz and LettuceK
events.short: Wemmbu robs LettuceK, the future LAW leader
events.desc: Stranded on the Pirate Islands, Wemmbu and Eggchan find a house belonging to two diamond-armored players, loppezz and LettuceK, and threaten to blow it up unless they hand over their gear. It's a small robbery, and his first run-in with LettuceK.

events.name: BAT accuses Parrot of being the Director; he flees
events.short: BAT brands Parrot the Director; he flees
events.desc: Parrot finds a warning to run in his room, and BAT, convinced by planted evidence, accuses him of being The Director. He flees and goes into hiding, with JumperWho secretly helping him as a disguised spy. Only after BAT watches Parrot meet the real Director do they believe he's innocent.

events.name: Wemmbu traps Jaden in the abandoned underground civilization
events.short: Wemmbu traps Jaden in the abandoned civilization
events.desc: Wemmbu chases Jaden_MAN into an abandoned, warden-filled underground civilization. After Jaden's wardens kill their peaceful ally Rejoicin, Wemmbu pops all of Jaden's totems, strips his gear, removes every chorus fruit (an escape item) and leaves him trapped underground.

events.name: Wemmbu-FlameFrags rematch at Flame's house ends in a disputed draw
events.short: Wemmbu and Flame's rematch ends in a disputed draw
events.desc: Wemmbu shows up at FlameFrags's house demanding a rematch. Wemmbu's elytra-mace attacks nearly kill Flame, but Flame counters with slow-falling potions. Neither can finish the other, so they call the fight off as a draw, argue over who really won, then Flame gives Wemmbu a tour of his base.

events.name: Spoke, posing as the Director, infiltrates BAT's void base
events.short: Spoke poses as the Director in BAT's base
events.desc: Spoke sneaks invisibly into the Bounty Assassin Team's secret void base, hides there and pranks them, stealing from them and calling himself 'The Director'. BAT catches him and locks him in an interrogation room, but he escapes with chorus fruit. It's a prank, but it muddies BAT's hunt for the real Director.

events.name: Wemmbu and MinuteTech stop Baablu's ender-dragon plot
events.short: Wemmbu and MinuteTech foil Baablu's dragon plot
events.desc: Wemmbu helps Baablu respawn the ender dragon, then learns Baablu and Fantst plan to farm dragons and destroy spawn. He teams up with MinuteTech, guardian of the End whom he had just fought, and together they fight off the whole team, starting their friendship.

events.name: Flame kills T0X1N and rescues Ashen
events.short: Flame kills T0X1N and rescues his wolf Ashen
events.desc: Toxic players kidnap FlameFrags's wolf Ashen. Flame fights through their bases, then beats T0X1N's commanders. T0X1N tries to execute him with a rigged launch, but Flame survives using a hidden wind charge, kills T0X1N and frees Ashen. The toxic clan's war on him goes on until he kills its leader VEN0M.

events.name: The Director is revealed to be Wifies
events.short: The Director is revealed to be Wifies
events.desc: Parrot and Leow0ok rescue JumperWho and Derapchu from the Director's trap, and the Director reveals himself: he is Wifies, Parrot's best friend, who faked his death. Wifies says he did it all to protect and study Parrot, and threatens Parrot's friends unless he follows. Parrot goes with him.

lines: The Director is revealed to be

events.name: Flame moves into Lomedy's base
events.short: Flame moves in with Lomedy
events.desc: Looking for a base to stay in, FlameFrags settles at the farmer Lomedy's place. Lomedy helps him beat the mace-wielding VEN0M's clan, lending him a mace and building TNT machines, and asks to join Flame's journey. Flame says he works better alone, but this is the start of their partnership.

events.name: FlameFrags beats Wemmbu in the final of AJTHEBOLD's PvP tournament
events.short: Flame beats Wemmbu in the tournament final
events.desc: Wemmbu and FlameFrags both fight through AJTHEBOLD's PvP tournament, held to find the server's strongest fighter, and meet in the final. Flame narrowly outplays Wemmbu, wins the tournament and teases him about it, cementing Flame as the top fighter.

events.name: Spoke founds the 1000-player Spoke Galactic Empire
events.short: Spoke founds the Spoke Galactic Empire
events.desc: Spoke claims a piece of land as the capital of the Spoke Galactic Empire and gathers an army of about 1000 players. He leads raids on Hannahxxrose and MinuteTech, but his own citizens keep burning houses and trying to assassinate him.

events.name: Flame rescues Jaden from the Abandoned Civilization and forms the Avengers to hunt Wemmbu
events.short: Flame rescues Jaden and forms the Avengers
events.desc: Searching for his missing friend Jaden_MAN, FlameFrags clashes with LettuceK's bounty hunters, The Law, and with Leow0ok's help finds Jaden in the Abandoned Civilization where Wemmbu trapped him. Jaden asks Flame to kill Wemmbu, and they recruit Wemmbu's old enemies into a team called the Avengers.

events.name: Flame betrays the Avengers and returns Wemmbu's mace
events.short: Flame betrays the Avengers, returns Wemmbu's mace
events.desc: The Avengers hunt Wemmbu in the Far Lands, the glitched edge of the world, while FlameFrags tricks Sharpness out of the mace he stole from Wemmbu. At the showdown Flame betrays the team, kills them with that mace and hands it back to Wemmbu.

events.name: Spoke's 1000-player army turns on him
events.short: Spoke's 1000-player army turns on him
events.desc: Spoke loses control of his 1000-player army, which turns on him. Led by a masked figure calling himself 'The Executive', they overrun Spoke and Mapicc's bases and chase them through the Nether to Leow0ok's base, where Leo helps them fight off the hunters.

events.name: Jaden betrays Flame at the LAW base
events.short: Jaden betrays Flame at the LAW base
events.desc: FlameFrags tries to get netherite armor for Jaden_MAN and helps him rob a town, but Jaden won't help when the Law attacks. When the two raid the Law's base, Jaden betrays Flame and leaves him to die; LettuceK reveals Jaden set him up. Flame survives, and Jaden becomes his enemy.

events.name: Parrot escapes Paragon, killing Wifies, and Theo saves him at spawn
events.short: Parrot escapes Paragon; Wifies dies
events.desc: Imprisoned by Wifies in Paragon, a prison guarded by Parrot's blackmailed friends, Parrot ends up in a final standoff on a TNT-rigged floor. He drops the spyglass from their friendship; Wifies steps off to grab it and the trap kills him. Parrot escapes to a ruined spawn, where TheobaldTheBird saves him from a wither.

events.name: Jaden attacks Lomedy and steals one of his maces
events.short: Jaden steals Lomedy's mace
events.desc: Jaden_MAN watches FlameFrags and Lomedy rebuild Flame's base, then ambushes Lomedy and steals one of his two maces. Flame chases him, but when rain lets Jaden combine his mace with a trident, Flame is forced into hiding. The mace theft deepens the feud between the former friends.

events.name: Wemmbu finds the orbital strike cannons beyond the Far Lands
events.short: Wemmbu gets the orbital strike cannons
events.desc: Searching the Far Lands, the glitched edge of the world, Wemmbu and Eggchan reach a hidden city in the void and find its repeating orbital strike cannons: redstone superweapons that rain TNT on any chosen spot. The locals trick them into an end portal, but Wemmbu now has the weapon he will be known for.

events.name: Spoke and Mapicc join Leow0ok's Bounty Assassin Team
events.short: Spoke joins the Bounty Assassin Team
events.desc: Leow0ok, leader of the Bounty Assassin Team (BAT), an elite group of assassins and bounty hunters, ambushes Spoke and Mapicc. Instead of killing them he makes them try out for BAT, and Spoke bluffs and schemes his way through the missions, starting his long, dangerous double life inside the team.

events.name: Spoke, invisible, sends Flame on quests
events.short: Invisible Spoke sends Flame on errands
events.desc: Broke and desperate, FlameFrags runs errands for a mysterious invisible player who promises riches: recovering stolen potions, finding a ghast, wiping out the Skullhound bandits. The stranger turns out to be Spoke, who is using Flame to clear his own BAT tryout missions and is quietly steering him into a trap.

events.name: Wemmbu's orbital strikes defeat Flame at the Mafia stash
events.short: Wemmbu's orbital strikes crush Flame
events.desc: Spoke's final errand sends Flame to an old Mafia stash, where Wemmbu is waiting with his new orbital strike cannons. The TNT strikes overwhelm Flame and break his prized chestplate, and Wemmbu claims the title of strongest player. An invisible Spoke slips Flame potions and totems, and uses the fight to fake a kill for BAT.

events.name: Wemmbu fakes his death; Flame is told at Capital City
events.short: Wemmbu fakes his death
events.desc: Tired of endless fights, Wemmbu fakes his death and starts over in disguise: invisible, using a voice changer, serving in Capital City's guard force. Word spreads that he is dead, and that is what Flame is told at Capital City. But Boosfer and Boomie learn the truth, so Wemmbu vows to silence them.

events.name: Wemmbu, as the Invisible Knight, kills Boomie in front of Parrot
events.short: Wemmbu kills Boomie in front of Parrot
events.desc: Still in disguise, Wemmbu joins Jaden_MAN's pirates in the Great Sea and hunts down Boomie, who knows his secret. He kills Boomie with an orbital strike right after ParrotX2 has rescued him. Parrot doesn't know who the invisible killer is, but vows to stop him.

events.name: Desert void-trap battle; Flame turns on Boosfer
events.short: Flame turns on Boosfer at the desert void trap
events.desc: Flame has been working for Boosfer, who promised news of Wemmbu. The disguised Wemmbu and Capital City's guards lure them into a desert void trap, which fails. Then Wemmbu, still unrecognised, convinces Flame that Boosfer has been lying all along. Flame turns on Boosfer, who flees into the Nether.

events.name: Wemmbu escapes the Underworld with Boosfer
events.short: Wemmbu escapes the Underworld
events.desc: Chasing Boosfer into the Nether, Wemmbu falls with him through a void trap into the Underworld, a hidden dimension below the Nether where blocks can't be broken. Jailed by its Soul Keepers, the enemies team up to escape. Wemmbu spares Boosfer in exchange for keeping his identity secret.

events.name: Flame and Parrot's Nether alliance against ClownPierce
events.short: Flame and Parrot raid ClownPierce's Nether
events.desc: Flame enters the Nether to kill its ruler ClownPierce and teams up with Parrot and Theo, who are after Clown's vault. When he overhears Parrot admit he is only using him, Flame sells them out to Clown, then turns on Clown to save them. Parrot loots the vault and agrees to find out what happened to Wemmbu.

events.name: Spoke finds a full-invisibility exploit
events.short: Spoke finds a full-invisibility exploit
events.desc: Mapicc discovers a glitch that makes a player truly invisible, even in armour. He and Spoke use it to prank a new player and wage a prank war on the griefer ApexPoint's team, ending with Spoke tricking ApexPoint into a dripstone trap. The exploit gives Spoke a new trick for later schemes.

events.name: Parrot impersonates the Invisible Knight; Wemmbu kills Sky at Boosfer's trials
events.short: Parrot poses as the Invisible Knight; Wemmbu kills Sky
events.desc: Parrot and Theo dress exactly like the invisible guard everyone now calls the Invisible Knight, to draw him out. At Boosfer's base, where Boosfer can't tell the 'Wemmbus' apart and sets them trials, the real Wemmbu attacks and kills Sky, Parrot and Theo's Happy Ghast. The two impostors escape, but the hunt is on.

events.name: Parrot and Flame unmask Wemmbu in the dome trap
events.short: Parrot and Flame unmask Wemmbu
events.desc: Working with Flame, Parrot lures the Invisible Knight through trap after trap into a TNT dome far from spawn. Trying to escape, the Knight sets off the TNT himself, and the death messages of the wolves it kills show his real name: Wemmbu. His faked death is exposed, and Flame demands a rematch.

events.name: The LAW breaks up the Wemmbu-Flame rematch; deal at LAW HQ
events.short: LAW interrupts the Wemmbu-Flame rematch
events.desc: Flame and Wemmbu's rematch keeps getting ambushed by the LAW, LettuceK's police force, so the rivals team up and corner Lettuce at LAW HQ. Killing him would turn the server against them, so they make a deal: they will fight his entire army, and if they win, the LAW leaves them alone.

events.name: Parrot finds the Tomb of the Mafia and leaves it untouched
events.short: Parrot reaches the Tomb of the Mafia
events.desc: Parrot and Theo reach the Invisible Mafia's treasure tomb far out in the End, guarded by the invisible Marlowww. Her journals show she guards it to protect others, because looting it would kill the surviving Mafia members. Parrot takes nothing, gives up treasure hunting, and wonders what to do next.

events.name: Wemmbu and Flame win 2 vs 1000 at the statue
events.short: Wemmbu and Flame win 2 vs 1000 at the statue
events.desc: Wemmbu and Flame face LettuceK's 1,000-player LAW army at a giant statue and wipe it out with orbital strikes, TNT minecarts and maces. Then Flame turns on the exhausted Wemmbu and makes him admit that Flame is the strongest player. Lettuce, watching, hints that this was part of a bigger plan.

events.name: LettuceK arrests Wemmbu
events.short: LettuceK arrests Wemmbu
events.desc: Drained after the battle and his duel with Flame, Wemmbu is easy prey for LettuceK, who takes him prisoner. Stripped of his gear, he is locked in the LAW's prison with old enemies Baablu and Fantst, and Lettuce plans to use him as a trophy to show the server what the LAW can do.

events.name: Leow0ok hands Spoke to the LAW; Spoke escapes during LettuceK's speech
events.short: Leo hands Spoke to the LAW; Spoke escapes
