events.desc: Leow0ok suspects Spoke of crimes he can't prove, so he hands him over to the LAW. At the Northern Council, Spoke slips into the crowd during LettuceK's speech and escapes, already planning to get Wemmbu to kill Leo for him. His break with BAT is now open war.

lines: Leo hands Spoke to the LAW;

events.name: LettuceK announces an election for King at the Northern Council
events.short: LettuceK announces an election for King
events.desc: At the Northern Council, LettuceK, leader of the LAW, tells the server it needs a king and announces an election: anyone with 100 votes can run. He parades the captive Wemmbu and promises to execute him if elected. Flame watches in secret, Parrot decides to run, and Spoke sees an opening.

events.name: Spoke splashes Wemmbu with invisibility and offers him a deal in prison
events.short: Spoke offers the jailed Wemmbu a deal
events.desc: After the speech, an invisible Spoke splashes the prisoner Wemmbu with invisibility so he can run, but Wemmbu is recaptured and thrown into solitary. Spoke sneaks in and offers to free him in return for using his orbital strike cannons. Wemmbu refuses, fearing he would become Spoke's servant.

events.name: LettuceK exiles FlameFrags from Capital City
events.short: LettuceK exiles Flame
events.desc: LettuceK turns the server against Flame: Capital City drives him out, and after he saves his friend Lomedy from the LAW, Lettuce's hidden army of netherite-armoured soldiers beats him. With his base taken and his name ruined, Flame rides into exile, vowing not to return until he has mastered combat.

events.name: Treebo Village's votes put Parrot in the election
events.short: Treebo Village's votes get Parrot into the race
events.desc: Following notes from a mysterious 'Owl', Parrot and Theo travel to remote Treebo Village, rescue a hostage from the Phantom bandits and defend the village. The grateful villagers give Parrot just over 100 votes, enough to make him a candidate for king, though he starts at the very bottom.

events.name: The LAW arrests Lomedy
events.short: The LAW arrests Lomedy
events.desc: In exile, Flame hides at Lomedy's farm and practises a new wind-charge and ender pearl technique. LAW officers led by Deputy_Ace attack and destroy the farm, and with Flame about to die, Lomedy surrenders to the LAW to save him. Flame sets off to find people who can train him.

events.name: ItzRealMe trains Flame and teaches him the Zone
events.short: ItzRealMe teaches Flame the Zone
events.desc: Flame finds ItzRealMe, the retired former best PvP player in Minecraft, who tests him with every weapon, teaches him advanced mace tricks and shows him 'the zone', a state of total focus. Flame uses it to wipe out a LAW patrol, then beats Itz in a final duel.

events.name: Spoke breaks Wemmbu and the prisoners out of the LAW prison
events.short: Spoke breaks Wemmbu out of the LAW prison
events.desc: After weeks of failed escape attempts, and facing execution, Wemmbu finally accepts Spoke's deal. Spoke kills the guards and breaks him out along with PrinceZam, Baablu and Fantst, though Lomedy chooses to stay. In return, Wemmbu owes Spoke a favour: helping kill BAT leader Leow0ok.

events.name: Ambush on Leow0ok at his stasis in the old BAT base
events.short: Spoke and Wemmbu ambush Leow0ok's stasis
events.desc: Spoke, Wemmbu, Mapicc and PrinceZam find Leow0ok's stasis chamber, an ender pearl setup that can teleport him, in an old BAT base, and use it to pull him into an ambush. Leo survives, and when Spoke's invisibility runs out, Leo finally has proof against him and teleports away.

events.name: Leow0ok tells Spoke he killed Mapicc
events.short: Leow0ok tells Spoke he killed Mapicc
events.desc: Mapicc vanishes on a supply run, and Spoke finds signs of a fight. Leow0ok then ambushes him carrying Mapicc's shield and claims he killed Mapicc. Grieving and furious, Spoke sets out to make the server pay.

events.name: Jaden saves Wemmbu and Egg from Deputy_Ace; Wemmbu joins Jaden's Pirates against the LAW
events.short: Jaden saves Wemmbu; they ally against the LAW
events.desc: On the run from the LAW, Wemmbu and Eggchan are cornered by Deputy_Ace's lawmen until Jaden_MAN, Wemmbu's old pirate rival, saves them with his Pirates. Jaden offers them safety in the Great Sea if they help fight the LAW, which is building a giant cannon to destroy the Pirates, and Wemmbu agrees.

events.name: Parrot talks Spoke out of blowing up Capitol City at the first debate
events.short: Parrot talks Spoke out of blowing up Capitol City
events.desc: Sure Mapicc is dead, Spoke rigs Capitol City with TNT while the first election debate is going on. Parrot sneaks up, breaks his cannon and talks him down, then points out that the shield Leo showed him has the same pattern as JumperWho's, so Mapicc may still be alive. Spoke sets out to find him.

events.name: Spoke finds Mapicc alive with JamatoP
events.short: Spoke finds Mapicc alive with JamatoP
events.desc: Following a trail, Spoke finds Mapicc alive with JamatoP, Spoke's first friend, long thought gone. Rather than feel grateful, Spoke feels betrayed. He confronts Jamato, then secretly fakes Jamato's death and blames Leo, so he keeps Mapicc and Zam to himself.

events.name: Parrot survives the election purge with Fymada and Horace
events.short: Parrot allies with Fymada and Horace in the purge
events.desc: After a candidate is assassinated, LettuceK declares 'The Purge': 24 hours in which candidates may attack each other for vote books. Parrot refuses to fight dirty and instead rescues candidates Horace and Fymada. Impressed, they hand him their votes and back him, lifting him into the final four.

events.name: Wemmbu and Jaden's pirates destroy the LAW's orbital cannon in the Great Sea
events.short: Wemmbu destroys the LAW's orbital cannon
events.desc: The LAW finishes a giant orbital cannon aimed at Pirate City, and LettuceK launches Wemmbu far out to sea. Re-armed by the hermit Linnwyrm, Wemmbu returns with Eggchan and blows the cannon up, saving the Great Sea, but Jaden is captured and Pirate City is left nearly empty.

events.name: Parrot finds Wemmbu at Pirate City and brings him to the second debate
events.short: Parrot brings Wemmbu to the second debate
events.desc: Parrot finds Wemmbu at abandoned Pirate City, apologises for exposing him, and sneaks him across LAW territory. They burst into the final-four debate, proving LettuceK lost his prized prisoner. Wemmbu escapes, and the exposed Lettuce puts the election on hold and reveals he holds Theo hostage.

events.name: Deputy_Ace betrays LettuceK to save Parrot and is banned
events.short: Deputy_Ace dies saving Parrot from LettuceK
events.desc: After LettuceK declares himself king and jails Parrot, his own deputy, Deputy_Ace, secretly frees him. When Lettuce orders Parrot and Theo executed, Ace kills the guards instead and holds Lettuce off so they can escape, dying with the words 'I'd rather die standing than live kneeling.' Parrot decides to fight.

events.name: Wemmbu reclaims his orbital cannons in the Far Lands
events.short: Wemmbu reclaims his orbital cannons
events.desc: Wemmbu and Eggchan trick JamatoP into guiding them across the Far Lands, then turn on him. After fighting off the void city's Nitenly and Serpentbound, Wemmbu reloads his orbital strike cannons and jumps through an end portal, once again the most heavily armed player on the server.

events.name: MinuteTech sides with Wemmbu; LettuceK reveals he holds Jaden's life hostage
events.short: LettuceK holds Jaden hostage over Wemmbu
events.desc: Wemmbu convinces MinuteTech, guardian of the End, that LettuceK is corrupt, and Minute helps him escape the LAW-occupied End. Wemmbu then wipes out Lettuce's army at the Northern Council with orbital strikes, but Lettuce stops him cold: one pull of his fishing rod will kill Wemmbu's captive ally Jaden_MAN.

events.name: JumperWho saves PrinceZam from Leow0ok and breaks with BAT to side with Spoke
events.short: JumperWho breaks with Leo and allies with Spoke
events.desc: With Leow0ok's LAW army closing in, BAT spymaster JumperWho, who left the team over Leo using her spies as soldiers, saves PrinceZam from him with buried charged creepers. Spoke distrusts her, but after Leo's railguns blast his base, he accepts her alliance.

events.name: Spoke kills Leow0ok with his rigged stasis; Mapicc goes missing
events.short: Spoke kills Leow0ok; Mapicc goes missing
events.desc: During the battle at the Northern Council, where the LAW is defeated, Mapicc goes missing. Afterwards JumperWho's spies find the weakened Leow0ok, and Spoke and Jumper break his armour. Leo pulls his stasis to escape, not knowing Spoke has rigged it, and it drops him into the void.

events.name: Flame returns Lomedy's mace and promises to change
events.short: Flame gives Lomedy his mace back and makes peace
events.desc: Flame helps defeat LettuceK, and the jailed Lettuce urges him to prove he can change. Flame goes to the ruined LAW prison, apologises to Lomedy for the farm, the mace and everything else, and hands his mace back. Lomedy forgives him on one condition: that he really does change.

events.name: Parrot is crowned King of the Unstable SMP
events.short: Parrot is crowned King
events.desc: With the LAW defeated, Parrot resumes the election and wins it, becoming the first elected King of the Unstable SMP. Booed by players who wanted LettuceK, he vows to make spawn safe within 100 days or resign, clears it of withers and feeds the server, yet many older players still resent him.

events.name: Wemmbu recovers the Wheat Kingdom's lost mace
events.short: Wemmbu recovers the Wheat Kingdom's lost mace
events.desc: Now living peacefully, Wemmbu agrees to recover a lost mace for a wheat-farming village. He wins a 4v4 tournament with Eggchan and Jaden_MAN to learn where its tomb is and gets through its traps. A mysterious invisible fighter grabs the mace first, but Wemmbu beats them, and the village gets its mace back.

events.name: Flame joins the LAW for 100 days to keep his Megabase
events.short: Flame joins the LAW
events.desc: The LAW, now without Lettuce, wants back the megabase it built Flame. To keep it, he must serve 100 days as a LAW elite with Lomedy and Spongs, fighting Arachn1d's gang. Flame, who the LAW once exiled, refuses to join Arachn1d's new kingdom and visits the jailed LettuceK.

events.name: Capital City Police frame Parrot; he clears his name
events.short: Parrot is framed by Capital City Police
events.desc: King Parrot is framed for 43 murders in Capitol City and sentenced to death by the city's corrupt police, mercenaries working for whoever pays most. Merchant City's guards free him, and with Theo and Fymada he exposes the police's plot to kill new players, but whoever is really behind it remains hidden.

events.name: The Kingdom of the Caves captures Egg; Wemmbu gets him back
events.short: Wemmbu rescues Egg from the Kingdom of the Caves
events.desc: An army working with Arachn1d, whose underground Kingdom of the Caves wants Wemmbu, kidnaps his best friend Eggchan. Wemmbu trails them to the allied Sculk Kingdom, beats its leader driftop99 in a duel, routs Yungyx's army and frees Egg, though Egg's journal of server lore ends up in an invisible stranger's hands.

events.name: Flame kills Mistrul in the Zone and destroys the Mist
events.short: Flame kills Mistrul and wipes out the Mist
events.desc: Hired to kill Mistrul, the feared leader of the hidden Mist civilization, Flame is betrayed by Flowtives and told Lomedy is dead. In grief he enters 'the zone', kills Mistrul in a duel and blasts his fighters with TNT, breaking the Mist's grip. Then he finds Lomedy alive, hiding the whole time.

events.name: Reina joins Parrot after Cindercrest wipes out Skymore
events.short: Cindercrest wipes out Skymore; Reina joins Parrot
events.desc: Parrot finds that all 1,000 settlers of Skymore, the colony he sent far from spawn, have vanished. Following survivor Zoe's clues, he learns that Cindercrest, a kingdom of old players, and its killer ShoeBilly took them and plan to retake spawn. Zoe's friend Reina, the last survivor, joins him.

events.name: NULL begins hunting Spoke
events.short: NULL begins hunting Spoke
events.desc: While searching for the missing Mapicc, Spoke is hunted by NULL: skinless bounty hunters with jumbled names who seem impossible to kill and carry Mapicc's shield pattern. With JumperWho he traces the bounty to SirPig_ and kills their leader with an arrow railgun, finding a book titled 'mission: null'.

events.name: Parrot wins over Merchant City and the LAW's soldiers; SargeLAW sides with Cindercrest
events.short: Parrot absorbs the LAW; SargeLAW sides with Cindercrest
events.desc: With Cindercrest days from invading, Parrot recruits bandits, takes DanchoGold hostage so Merchant City's guards join him, and buys TNT from ClownPierce. At the LAW's base, SargeLAW sides with Cindercrest, but many lawmen join Parrot, who blows up the rest and takes their gear.

events.name: Flame joins Cindercrest to protect Lomedy
events.short: Flame joins Cindercrest to protect Lomedy
events.desc: Lomedy believes Parrot's open spawn is starving old players and wants to join Cindercrest, Saparata's kingdom of old players sworn to overthrow him. Flame thinks it's a terrible idea and wants no part of the war, but joins anyway to keep his best friend safe.

events.name: Parrot raises an army of tens of thousands as Cindercrest's blimp marches on spawn
events.short: Parrot raises tens of thousands as Cindercrest marches
events.desc: Parrot opens spawn to recruits and builds an army of tens of thousands of players, with Fymada bringing her own forces. Meanwhile Theo and Reina, scouting, see Cindercrest's huge blimp, with Flame and ShoeBilly on top and thousands of netherite soldiers below, marching on spawn. War is a day away.

events.name: Spoke asks King Parrot for help with the missing players and is turned away
events.short: King Parrot turns away Spoke's plea for help
events.desc: Spoke and JumperWho show King ParrotX2 a NULL book listing missing players, mostly trappers and griefers from his own kingdom. Parrot doubts NULL even exists, says the vanished players were bad anyway, and offers only some supplies, so Spoke has to look for help elsewhere.

events.name: Parrot rescues Wemmbu from the Wraith; Wemmbu kills Cytharam
events.short: Wemmbu kills the Wraith agent Cytharam
events.desc: An invisible Wraith assassin hunting Eggchan captures Wemmbu in a flying machine, but ParrotX2 sneaks aboard and frees him. Refusing to hide, Wemmbu goes back and kills the assassin, Cytharam, then hears his name called by another player wearing the exact same armor trims.

events.name: NULL wipes out Jumper's spies; Mapicc returns to Spoke after a month missing
events.short: NULL wipes out Jumper's spies; Mapicc returns
events.desc: Spoke and JumperWho rally her spies to reach a pearl cannon (an ender pearl launcher for long-distance teleports) toward the missing players, but NULL's hunters blow it up and kill the spies Jumper swore to protect. Back at Spoke's hidden base, an invisible visitor drinks milk: it's Mapicc, missing for a month.

events.name: Spoke, Mapicc and JumperWho reach JamatoP in the Far Lands
events.short: Spoke's party finds JamatoP in the Far Lands
events.desc: Mapicc, who says he escaped NULL, leads Spoke and Jumper 12 million blocks out into the Far Lands, the glitched terrain at the world's edge where captives are taken. Dodging NULL's hunters through strange biomes, they find a hidden stairway, and at its bottom JamatoP, whom they thought dead, offers to help.

events.name: Battle for Fort Feather: the Civil War begins
events.short: Fort Feather falls: the Civil War begins
events.desc: Cindercrest, a kingdom of old players who blame King Parrot's open spawn for famine and bandits, attacks Fort Feather, his army's training ground. FlameFrags, who joined only to protect his friend Lomedy, drops in from a redstone blimp, and Parrot's mostly new-player army flees, starting the Civil War.

events.name: Egg is auctioned on the Wraith's island; Flame betrays Wemmbu
events.short: Egg auctioned to Arachn1d; Flame betrays Wemmbu
events.desc: Seeking Wemmbu's orbital strike cannons (huge TNT launchers that one-shot armored players), Flame and an invisible assassin kidnap Eggchan. The assassin betrays them and auctions Egg on his island; Flame, now helping Wemmbu, bids for Cindercrest instead, and Arachn1d wins Egg with his caves' whole treasury.

events.name: Battle for Merchant City
events.short: Battle for Merchant City
events.desc: Parrot fakes a surrender at Merchant City. Expecting a trap at the gate, Cindercrest's leader Saparata attacks with the blimp instead, exactly as Parrot planned: a new arrow cannon shreds the soldiers dropping from it and the Merchant City Vanguard finishes them, giving Parrot his first victory of the war.

events.name: Wemmbu kills Paramount; Arachn1d makes him a royal and his second-in-command
events.short: Wemmbu becomes Arachn1d's second-in-command
events.desc: Forced to serve Arachn1d's underground Kingdom of the Caves to keep Eggchan alive, Wemmbu climbs its ranks fast. Sent to assassinate ParamountX, leader of Highwater City, the kingdom's main food source, he kills him with one mace hit, and Arachn1d makes him royalty and his second-in-command.

events.name: Mapicc learns the truth from JamatoP, turns on Spoke and crits him out
events.short: Mapicc turns on Spoke after Jamato's reveal
events.desc: JamatoP secretly blackmails Spoke as he guides the group. Spoke, disguised as NULL, tries to kill him and fails, and Jamato tells Mapicc that Spoke, not Leow0ok, was behind an old attempt on Jamato's life. Feeling manipulated, Mapicc turns on Spoke and crits him down, breaking Alt, his long-held exploited armor piece.

events.name: JamatoP strips Spoke of everything and sends him to Purgatory
events.short: Jamato exposes Spoke and sends him to Purgatory
events.desc: Alone with Spoke, Jamato reveals he leads NULL, which captures 'bad' players, and that Spoke unknowingly led NULL to every rebel camp. After NULL seizes Mapicc, Jamato makes Spoke drop and burn all his gear and ender chest, then sends him through a portal to Purgatory, NULL's Nether prison.

events.name: Battle for Highwater City; Wemmbu nukes it but spares Parrot
events.short: Highwater City falls; Wemmbu spares Parrot
events.desc: Cindercrest targets Highwater City, source of 80% of Parrot's food. Arrow cannons wreck their army, but Saparata uses it as cover while Flame and ShoeBilly destroy the cannons, then Wemmbu and Arachn1d's army arrive. Wemmbu pops Parrot's last totem (an extra life) but, remembering Parrot saved him, lets him go.

events.name: Spoke knocks JamatoP down and starts a riot in Purgatory
events.short: Spoke starts a riot in Purgatory
events.desc: In Purgatory, Spoke's escapes fail, fellow prisoner Vixuality is killed, and Mapicc and Jumper are set for execution. Spoke swims through lava out of solitary, steals a mace, knocks Jamato off his platform and rallies the prisoners. The riot is crushed, but everyone now knows Jamato, not Spoke, is behind NULL.

events.name: Battle for Steampunk City
events.short: Battle for Steampunk City
events.desc: With Arachn1d's Kingdom of the Caves now allied to Cindercrest, the combined forces take Parrot's Steampunk City with little trouble. Wemmbu and Flame, on the same side for once, banter through the battle and try to steal each other's kills.

events.name: Parrot blows up Cindercrest's blimps, turns soldier73 into a mole and routs Cindercrest
events.short: Parrot's blimp raid and mole rout Cindercrest
events.desc: Parrot's soldiers rig Cindercrest's blimps with TNT and blow them up, escaping with the supplies despite a mace ambush by ShoeBilly. Parrot then turns soldier73, a captured Cindercrest assassin, into a mole, and his legions overrun Cindercrest's base, earning a festival from grateful new players.

events.name: Flame and Lomedy ambush Parrot, then defect from Cindercrest
events.short: Flame ambushes Parrot, then quits Cindercrest
events.desc: Doubting Cindercrest after Saparata sacrificed his own army at Highwater, Flame and Lomedy plan to kill Parrot, then Saparata. They jump Parrot at the Northern Council, but he breaks down, admits the starvation is his fault and dares them to kill him. They don't, and switch to his side.

events.name: Saparata defeats Parrot, exiles him and crowns himself king
events.short: Saparata overthrows and exiles Parrot
events.desc: At Capitol City, Parrot corners Saparata, until Wemmbu nukes the crowd and the city. Parrot's own army turns on him. At Spawn, Saparata reveals he means to kill every new player, outfights Parrot and watches him flee with a water-bucket clutch. Saparata crowns himself king, and Parrot is exiled.

events.name: Arachn1d betrays Wemmbu and drops him into the Purge
events.short: Arachn1d betrays Wemmbu into the Purge
events.desc: After Wemmbu massacres both sides at Capitol City on his orders, Arachn1d drops him into the Purge instead of freeing Eggchan: a free-for-all where cave citizens hunt him as a prize. Wemmbu gets out with his friends, but Egg's stasis is pulled, teleporting him back to captivity, and Wemmbu vows to kill Arachn1d.

events.name: Spoke survives JamatoP's Hunger Games in Purgatory
events.short: Spoke survives Jamato's Hunger Games
events.desc: Jamato forces Purgatory's prisoners into a Hunger Games where the last survivor supposedly goes free. Spoke teams with Mapicc, DylPickle and Found2, but Jamato rigs it, has Found2 killed and turns Dylan against him. Spoke still maces Jamato, then fakes leaving by Jamato's pearl cannon and hides in the arena.

events.name: Lomedy leaves Flame after the Civil War
events.short: Lomedy leaves Flame after the Civil War
events.desc: After Wemmbu's massacre at Capitol City, Lomedy tells Flame he's going back to his farm to help any friends still alive, and that being around someone obsessed with combat is wearing down his morals. Flame lets him go with his blessing, and is left on his own once again.

events.name: Flame and Wemmbu fight over Egg's pearls, then truce
events.short: Flame and Wemmbu fight, then call a truce
events.desc: Hungry for a rematch, Flame guards the stasis pearls that keep Eggchan captive and forces Wemmbu to fight for them. Wemmbu barely tries, so Flame calls a truce: he was always going to hand over the pearls, because friends don't take each other's friends away. Wemmbu promises him a real duel later.

events.name: Wemmbu frees Eggchan from Arachn1d; Yungyx becomes king of the Caves
events.short: Wemmbu frees Egg; Yungy kills Arachn1d
events.desc: Wemmbu pulls Eggchan free with his own pearl setup and beats Arachn1d in a duel. Arachn1d briefly forces the kingdom back to his side with a hidden thorns machine until Wemmbu shuts it down. As Arachn1d bargains, Yungyx kills him, then beats a worn-out Wemmbu in a duel to become king of the Caves.

events.name: JumperWho frees the Purgatory army Spoke was raising and leaves him
events.short: JumperWho frees Spoke's army behind his back
events.desc: Hiding in the arena with help from a rebel NULL commander, Spoke builds an army of prisoners to overthrow Jamato. JumperWho decides escaping matters more than fighting and leads the recruits out through the mines past the wall, calling Spoke insane and leaving him.

events.name: Spoke defeats JamatoP and takes control of NULL
events.short: Spoke takes control of NULL
events.desc: Spoke challenges Jamato for the Totem of NULL, the enchanted totem that controls the group, and the rebel commander sides with Spoke. When Jamato threatens Mapicc, Spoke knocks his friend into the void rather than back down. Beaten, Jamato surrenders the totem, and Spoke becomes NULL's new leader.

events.name: Parrot founds a new civilization in exile
events.short: Parrot founds a new civilization in exile
events.desc: Exiled from Spawn by Saparata, ParrotX2 travels thousands of blocks out to build a civilization strong enough to take him down. He settles in a small jungle and recruits his friendly neighbor PestoPasta2009, starting over from a single house and a wheat farm.

events.name: In exile, Parrot finds and cures Leow0ok's hidden villager
events.short: Parrot finds Leow0ok's hidden villager
events.desc: Pesto tells Parrot that his long-missing friend Leow0ok hid villagers across the server, most since killed by Nether king ClownPierce. Recalling Leo's figure-eight base, Parrot finds one zombified under a lake, wins it back from thieves with TNT minecarts and cures it. Its mending-book trades fund his civilization.

events.name: The LAW gives Flame a certificate and rebuilds his base; TheG0dofWar challenges him
events.short: Flame allies with the LAW; G0dofWar returns
events.desc: With his base in ruins, Flame asks SargeLAW of the LAW, the server's law-enforcement group, for help. A LAW certificate convinces the jailed LettuceK to reveal an old stash, and the LAW rebuilds Flame's base. Rival TheG0dofWar keeps returning for a rematch; Flame beats him, spares him and asks to be trained.

events.name: TheG0dofWar is killed; Antaggg cheats Flame and claims the win
events.short: TheG0dofWar is killed; Antag cheats Flame
events.desc: G0dofWar trains Flame in return for help retaking his old civilization of LAW elites from Antaggg, who exiled him. They beat its champions, but G0dofWar is killed by an arrow cannon. Flame then duels Antag, who cheats with henchmen and potion effects, runs off and claims the win anyway.

events.name: Falconu exposes Antaggg's cheating and allies with Flame
events.short: Falconu exposes Antag and allies with Flame
events.desc: Flame enters Antaggg's tournament to avenge G0dofWar and reaches the final, only to be drained and forced to surrender. Falconu, LettuceK's old second-in-command, reveals Antag cheated by secretly swapping places with other players, and offers Flame a fair fight with him in exchange for help.

events.name: Flame beats Antaggg in a fair 1v1
events.short: Flame finally beats Antag in a fair 1v1
events.desc: Flame and Falconu help the Canary civilization fight Antaggg's Warriors, who keep outsmarting them. During the final assault, Flame pulls Antag's hidden stasis pearl to drag him into a 1v1. Antag's own arrow cannon backfires on him, he concedes and flies off, and his Warriors join the Canary. G0dofWar is avenged.

events.name: Spoke leads NULL into the End; MinuteTech kills the dragon
events.short: Spoke leads NULL into the End
events.desc: Now leading NULL, Spoke invades the End, overpowers its guardian MinuteTech and wipes out villages to build an empire. Minute destroys the End's exit portal, trapping everyone, so Spoke hunts for the end crystals needed to respawn the dragon. When it returns, Minute kills it himself and leaves to find help.

events.name: Cloudwatch's fake vault traps Flame in Terminus
events.short: Cloudwatch traps Flame in the Terminus prison
events.desc: Cloudwatch recruits Flame and NotSkrilley to find a legendary vault that could help the server's weaker players. After battling a rival Resistance and ClownPierce's guards to reach it, Cloud reveals there is no vault: it's a trap to eliminate overpowered players like Flame. He teleports away as TNT rains down.

events.name: LettuceK returns as a Rank 3 captain of Cindercrest, running Terminus
events.short: LettuceK returns as a Cindercrest captain
events.desc: Trapped in Terminus, Cindercrest's maximum-security prison, Flame meets LettuceK, the LAW's former leader, now a Rank 3 captain of Cindercrest sent to oversee him. Lettuce warns that the harder Flame tries to escape, the worse it gets for everyone, while Cindercrest broadcasts his capture as a show of strength.

events.name: Flame escapes Terminus as ten factions raid it
events.short: Flame escapes Terminus as ten factions raid it
events.desc: Lettuce's offer to let Flame out by joining Cindercrest turns into a trap set by Cloudwatch, who wants him dead. Then ten factions, including the LAW, raid Terminus. Someone spawns a wither that breaks Flame's obsidian cell, and he walks out amid the battle, though Skrilley is left behind.

events.name: JamatoP escapes Spoke's custody; Spoke trades his mace for an end crystal
events.short: Jamato escapes Spoke; Spoke trades away his mace
events.desc: Spoke forces his prisoner Jamato to build Wither Cannons (machines that launch wither skulls) by threatening to burn his history books. Jamato then vanishes along with his guards. Meanwhile, Spoke gets the third end crystal from the trader TimeDeo by giving up his mace, a sign of how badly he needs out.

events.name: NULL invades the Overworld and seizes its End portals
events.short: NULL invades the Overworld
events.desc: Spoke leads NULL through the End's exit portal into the Overworld, blows up Cindercrest's spawn trap and starts seizing every End portal stronghold, killing all defenders. Jamato warns him an army stronger than NULL already exists, and NULL builds a huge Purgatory-style city as its new base.

events.name: Parrot defeats Saparata, then ClownPierce captures him
events.short: Parrot beats Saparata, then ClownPierce captures him
events.desc: Tipped off by a jealous resident, Saparata attacks Parrot's new civilization, but Parrot's 'immortality machines' (stasis rigs that save a player when their totem pops) crush his army. Pesto dies winning back the stolen villager. Later, Nether king ClownPierce seizes Parrot and demands the villager's location.

events.name: JumperWho's invisible army turns on NULL; she escapes Spoke through a portal
events.short: JumperWho turns on Spoke and escapes
events.desc: Invisible players claiming to be from Purgatory ambush NULL and capture six of its strongholds. JumperWho, who had turned up at his base, confronts him at the Vael Company stronghold and begs him to pop the Totem of NULL and stop. Spoke orders her killed; she escapes through a portal, saying he never had a good heart.

events.name: Spoke traps Mapicc in the Underworld
events.short: Spoke traps Mapicc in the Underworld
events.desc: Spoke drops into the Underworld, a dimension below the Nether where blocks can't be placed, to decode Jamato's book about 'The Tomb'. Forced into a truce with Mapicc, whom he knocked there, he clears puzzle dungeons to reach the Citadel library, then escapes alone and seals Mapicc in behind him.

events.name: Saparata puts an 80,000-diamond bounty on Wemmbu; Flowtives hunts him
events.short: Saparata puts 80k diamonds on Wemmbu's head
events.desc: With King Saparata banning new players amid famine, master assassin Flowtives finds Wemmbu at his ruined base: Saparata has put an 80,000-diamond bounty on him. Flow's slow-falling arrows blunt Wemmbu's mace until MinuteTech re-gears him, then Minute warns them Spoke's NULL has taken over the End.

events.name: NULL besieges the Far Lands; Wemmbu's orbital cannons blow up as Spoke loads them
events.short: Wemmbu's orbital cannons destroyed
events.desc: After Wemmbu refuses to join NULL, Spoke tracks down his orbital cannons deep in the Far Lands with a shulker tracker and besieges them. Despite Wemmbu's barrages, NULL reaches the cannons, and they blow up as Spoke tries to load them, stripping Wemmbu of his greatest weapon. Spoke then turns every Wither Cannon on Wemmbu, who survives.

events.name: NULL wither-cannons the OG players' city; Serpentbound logs off
events.short: NULL wither-cannons the City of Gods
events.desc: Wemmbu reaches the hidden city of the First Generation (OG) players. NULL's Wither Cannons level it, but leader Serpentbound333 destroys its valuables so NULL can't have them, tells Wemmbu to travel to The Forge to find a way to beat NULL, gives him a compass, and logs off for months.

events.name: MinuteTech holds off NULL at the Far Lands entrance and is captured by Spoke's Wraiths
events.short: NULL captures MinuteTech
events.desc: When NULL reaches the Far Lands entrance, MinuteTech stays behind to hold them off so Wemmbu's group can push on. Spoke's newly recruited Wraith assassins capture him, and Spoke strips him of his elytra, armor and mace and has him escorted to the End as a prisoner.

events.name: Nitenly bans Jaden; Wemmbu escapes NULL into the Underworld
events.short: Jaden is banned; Wemmbu flees NULL
events.desc: Following Serpentbound's compass, Wemmbu clashes with OG player Firestar over his recklessness, and Nitenly splits off and joins NULL. At CookieBunsquat's city, Nitenly bans Jaden_MAN as he covers Wemmbu. Firestar holds NULL back so Wemmbu and Eggchan can escape through a portal into the Underworld.

events.name: SnowLicker is exposed as Clown's informer; Parrot learns Clown plans to invade the Overworld
events.short: SnowLicker betrays Parrot; Clown plans an invasion
events.desc: In ClownPierce's Nether mining prison, Parrot joins SnowLicker's escape crew. When hidden ancient debris (the prison's currency) vanishes and Snow kills a teammate as the thief, Parrot exposes Snow as Clown's informer, then overhears Clown promise him freedom once he invades the Overworld in six weeks.

events.name: ClownPierce's Nether Kingdom attacks NULL's capital; Spoke retreats into the End
events.short: Clown's Nether Kingdom drives NULL from its capital
events.desc: As NULL celebrates its Far Lands victory, ClownPierce, king of the Nether, comes through a portal and orders Spoke to stop using the Nether to move his armies. Spoke laughs him off, and the Nether Kingdom's soldiers pour out of portals and bomb the city with TNT minecarts until Spoke pulls NULL back into the End. It starts a war between the rulers of the two dimensions.

events.name: Spoke and ClownPierce agree that neither the End Empire nor the Nether Kingdom will invade the Overworld
events.short: Spoke and Clown agree to leave the Overworld alone
events.desc: Mid-way through an arms race between the two empires, Clown calls Spoke to a parley at a Nether portal, with invisible NULL soldiers hidden around them. Clown demands that NULL stay out of his territory and proposes that neither empire invade the Overworld; Spoke agrees. Parrot had learned that Clown planned to invade the Overworld, and MinuteTech that NULL did.

events.name: Parrot escapes ClownPierce's mining prison into the Underworld; NULL captures him on his return to the Overworld
events.short: Parrot escapes Clown's prison; NULL captures him
events.desc: Finding only more wastelands beyond the walls, Parrot notices void deaths show as fall damage, so something lies below. He leads the prisoners down into the Underworld while SnowLicker sacrifices himself to stop Clown's guards. When Parrot finally steps back into the Overworld, NULL seizes him and sends him to the End.

events.name: NULL and the freed Worms retake NULL's capital from the Nether Kingdom
events.short: NULL and the Worms retake Spoke's capital
events.desc: Spoke stumbles into a mining pit whose ignorant workers, the Worms, dig for ten monarchs above. He arms them, lends their leader slicee his mace Vengeance, and they overthrow the monarchs. Together with NULL and a rod linked to two hundred Wardens, the Worms march on the capital the Nether Kingdom took and win it back.

events.name: TheOathBinder hunts down the 1,000 prisoners Parrot led into the Underworld
events.short: OathBinder kills the 1000; Parrot alone survives
events.desc: In the Underworld, TheOathBinder, who can build where no one else can, traps Parrot's 1,000 prisoners and starts killing them, predicting only Parrot will escape. Through mazes, wardens and a lava sea, the group dwindles until his last companions push him through a one-person portal and OathBinder kills them.

events.name: Parrot kills ____X____ for his first mace; MinuteTech betrays his plan, then yields
events.short: Parrot wins a mace; MinuteTech betrays, then yields
events.desc: Parrot must clear five floors of Spoke's prison. Fellow prisoner MinuteTech trains him to sword-fight; together they crack a door code and kill the guard ____X____, earning Parrot his first mace. On the last floor, where partners must fight, Minute admits he used Parrot to get through, but can't kill him and yields.

events.name: Parrot escapes Spoke's End prison and refuses to join NULL
events.short: Parrot escapes Spoke's prison and refuses NULL
events.desc: Free of the prison, Parrot confronts Spoke, who asks him to join NULL against Cindercrest and reminds him he once turned Spoke away. Parrot refuses, cuts ties, warns Spoke not to invade his kingdom, and drops through the End portal back to the Overworld.
